jobs.title: Senior Commercial Deal Desk Analyst
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We’re looking for a Senior Commercial Deal Desk Analyst to help build and scale 1Password’s Commercial Deal Desk capability within Revenue Operations. You’ll partner with Sales, Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams on complex commercial decisions, while turning what you learn into clear processes, guidance, and tools that help teams move faster with confidence. This role will help strengthen 1Password’s enterprise commercial capabilities as deal complexity and volume grow.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

  • 4+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Commercial Finance, or a related function within a Business-to-Business (B2B) Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Salesforce Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ)/Revenue Cloud, including resolving complex quoting and cross-object issues.

  • Strong understanding of commercial deal structures, including annual recurring revenue (ARR), multi-year agreements, amendments, renewals, co-terms, ramps, stub billing, bundled products, and discounting.

  • Demonstrated ability to build or improve processes, documentation, approval workflows, and commercial policies in an evolving environment.

  • Sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer and seller needs with pricing discipline, revenue integrity, and business risk.

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to influence effectively without formal authority and explain complex commercial concepts clearly.

  • Experience using artificial intelligence (AI), automation, or workflow tools to reduce manual work and improve the quote-to-cash process is preferred.

What you can expect:

  • Partner with Enterprise Account Executives (AEs), Sales Managers, Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations on complex, non-standard, and high-impact deals.

  • Advise on deal structure, pricing, terms, discounting, approvals, amendments, renewals, co-terms, ramps, bundled products, and other commercial considerations.

  • Review and execute deal submissions in Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud, ensuring quotes and contracts are accurate, complete, and ready for approval and invoicing.

  • Build the foundations of the Commercial Deal Desk, including intake processes, approval routing, discount governance, exception handling, service-level agreements (SLAs), and documentation.

  • Create playbooks, training materials, office hours, and practical guidance that help sales teams navigate commercial processes and quoting tools.

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows through automation, AI tooling, and CPQ configuration, while partnering with technical teams to implement scalable solutions.

  • Use deal data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to identify bottlenecks, improve deal quality, and recommend changes that support efficient, sustainable growth.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £60,000 GBP and £84,000 GBP, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Go SDK - Language Clients
jobs.description:
About the team

The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++ and C#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA.

The role

We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own ClickHouse's Go clients. You'll decide what the clients should do by talking to the developers who use them, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep Go expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: clickhouse-go and ch-go, and the collectors, pipelines, agents and tools that write millions of rows per second through your code.

What you'll do

  • Know who uses the clients and what they're trying to do. Define what good looks like (time to first query, error clarity, throughput, adoption by key integrations), measure it, and let that drive the roadmap.

  • Be the voice of ClickHouse for Go developers. Speak at GopherCon and Go meetups, and write the posts, tutorials and examples that developers and AI assistants find when they search for how to use ClickHouse from Go (SEO and GEO). Answer questions where the community asks them.

  • Own the Go clients and their ecosystem: clickhouse-go, ch-go, database/sql, releases and support. Evolve them without breaking the people who depend on them.

  • Keep the clients the fastest Go option for the fastest analytical database, and make sure the client is never the bottleneck. Performance is part of every release, not an afterthought: profile, change, measure again, catch regressions in CI, and publish the numbers.

  • Partner with the projects built on the clients, from the OpenTelemetry Collector to ClickHouse Grafana datasource and ClickPipes, and catch their regressions before they ship.

  • Review and co-maintain other clients, and take part in cross-client decisions on types, errors and protocol features.

  • Bring written proposals about where we invest next. You set direction rather than wait for it.

  • Make the clients enterprise-ready: TLS and mTLS, cloud authentication, safe credential handling, vulnerability response, a small dependency footprint, and the questions large Go shops ask before they adopt.

  • Shape the clients for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try.

  • Extend our AI development platform, with new workflows for maintaining the clients: consistency checks across languages, issue triage, release checks.

About you

  • Product-minded with a bias for action. You'd rather run an experiment and bring back data than wait for approval, you measure whether it worked, and you can explain what you chose not to build.

  • 5+ years in software, much of it on data-intensive systems: drivers, SDKs, ingestion, streaming, observability or analytics.

  • Deep Go expertise: the runtime and garbage collector, escape analysis, the memory model, pprof and the execution tracer. You reason about throughput and latency down to allocations and bytes on the wire, and you prove it with tests and benchmarks.

  • Strong Go concurrency instincts: context, goroutines and channels, bounded pools, backpressure, clean shutdown, and the leaks and races that come with each.

  • Beyond Go, productive in at least one more of our client languages (Python, JavaScript, Java, Rust, C++, C#). You'll review and co-own across clients.

  • You've built or substantially extended a Go module other engineers depend on. You understand semantic import versioning and treat breaking changes accordingly.

  • Strong grasp of database fundamentals: SQL, query execution and analytical workloads. Judgment about when to use database/sql and when to drop down to the protocol.

  • Enthusiastic about working in public. You've given talks or written technical content, or you're keen to, and you see it as part of the job rather than a distraction from it.

  • Thoughtful use of AI development tools, with the judgment to review what comes out.

  • Clear writing. Most coordination happens in design docs, PRs and RFCs.

Nice to have

  • ClickHouse, especially its type system and native format, or another columnar or OLAP engine.

  • Contributions to Go data or observability infrastructure: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Kafka clients, database drivers.

  • Building or maintaining a database/sql driver.

  • Apache Arrow or ADBC in Go.

  • Experience designing SDKs, docs or error messages with AI coding agents as the consumer.

  • Protocol or wire-format work on a database driver or network client.

Learn more

  • clickhouse-go on GitHub and ch-go on GitHub

  • ClickHouse Go client documentation

  • Chasing that 32 ms tail latency in ClickHouse

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

It is a high-volume, high-activity role: you will speak to a lot of customers every week. You earn the right to ask for the business by being useful to the people you work with.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Cloud Partner Integrations
jobs.description:
About the team

Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.

Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment.

The craft is finding the patterns underneath different integrations. As one of the first backend engineers, you'll help shape the technical defaults for this team. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control.

You won't be doing it alone. You'll work closely with your engineering manager, the product manager, a growing team, and experienced engineers across the broader org. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, let's talk.

What you'll do

You'll own an integration end to end: the design, the code, and the production system that keeps running after launch. The patterns you set there become defaults the rest of the team builds on.

Day to day, that looks like:

  • Owning the architecture: auth and identity flows, multi-tenancy, how data moves and where it's allowed to live, performance, and what happens in production

  • Running what you build. Which means owning the infrastructure, CI, deployment, observability behind it and on-call

  • Working on top of external platforms you can't change, and being straight about which risks are yours to manage and which aren't

  • Partnering closely with the internal teams whose services you depend on: iterating on product requirements, agreeing on interfaces and protocols, and proactively finding ways to keep moving

About you

These are the attributes of someone who will perform well in this role:

  • 8+ years building software, with a good chunk of it on data-heavy or integration-flavored systems

  • Preferably proficient in TypeScript or Go or comfortable contributing to each

  • Solid backend and systems instincts. You can reason about deployment topology, multi-tenancy, and data movement, and you're comfortable owning architectural tradeoffs you'll have to live with later

  • You've worked with modern auth protocols, service principals, and identity federation, and you know how to get it right across a trust boundary

  • You've built on someone else's platform and know what that's actually like: incomplete docs, unintended breaking changes, etc.

  • You're comfortable in ambiguity. You can ship before the spec is finished, make sensible calls under uncertainty, and flag the decisions that'll be hard to undo to your team before we bake them in.

  • You're good with other engineers. Much of the work runs through teams you don't own, and you earn their trust by how you think, not just what you commit.

  • You write well. Most of how we coordinate happens async in chats, design docs and RFCs

Nice to have

None of these are required, but any of them would be a bonus:

This is a full-time, permanent position.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Training and Evaluation Environments: Design and build scalable simulation environments for humanoid robots with physics engines such as MjLab and Isaac Lab. Work with AI researchers to create challenging training tasks, curricula and evaluation scenarios.

  • Asset Management: Build and curate our database of robot, object and scene assets - including import, validation, collision and physics properties, metadata and versioning - so that environments can be assembled quickly and reproducibly.

  • Simulation Benchmarking: Own rigorous, large-scale simulation benchmarks and evaluation sweeps that enable fast policy evaluation cycles, with statistically sound metrics, regression tracking and clear reporting to research teams.

  • Sim-to-Real Alignment: Work with hardware and control engineers to align simulation with reality through robot modeling, actuator and sensor models, system identification and validation against real-world data.

  • Use-Case Driven Environments: Work with product teams to turn real customer use cases into simulated environments and benchmarks that measure what matters for deployment.

Who we are looking for

    • Simulation Physics: Rigid-body dynamics and contact simulation, including solver parameters, numerical stability and the trade-offs between simulation speed and fidelity.

jobs.title: Arbetsterapeut till VE neurologi i Malmö
jobs.description: Gör skillnad. Varje dag.Önskar du ett stimulerande arbete på specialistnivå med teamarbete i fokus och där du som arbetsterapeut har en given roll? Vi söker en arbetsterapeut till vårdenhet neurologi i Malmö, tillhörande verksamhetsområde neurologi, rehabiliteringsmedicin, minnessjukdomar och geriatrik (VO NRMG).VO NRMG består av såväl sluten- som öppenvård i Malmö, Lund och Höör/Orup. Vid rehabilitering skapas grunden för att patienten trots sin skada eller sjukdom ska fungera optimalt och uppnå god livskvalitet avseende arbete, familj och fritid. Rehabiliteringsprocessen tar sin utgångspunkt i WHO:s Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF).Rehabiliteringspersonalen inom område neurologi arbetar i multidisciplinära team med patienten i centrum. Vi arbetar med fokus på kvalitet och med att integrera beprövad erfarenhet samt evidensbaserad kunskap för att uppnå god och jämlik vård. På våra neurologiska avdelningar erbjuds interdisciplinärt rehabiliteringsmedicinsk bedömning och rehabilitering av personer, företrädesvis i aktiv ålder med aktivitetsnedsättning på grund av skada i nervsystemet, i rörelseapparaten eller på grund av långvarig smärta. Vi arbetar med fokus på kvalitet och med att integrera beprövad erfarenhet samt evidensbaserad kunskap för att uppnå god och jämlik vård. Vi har även ett utökat uppdrag inom nationellt högspecialiserad vård till vår enhet inom det neuromuskulära teamet.1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERVi söker dig som har intresse för placering inom slutenvård och/eller öppenvård. Inom slutenvården ingår vår Neuro-OBS som är en intermediärvårdsavdelning med snabbspår för stroke som kräver specifika arbetsterapeutiska åtgärder. Som arbetsterapeut deltar du i planeringen vid utskrivning från slutenvård till hemmiljö, med syfte att genomföra rehabiliterande insatser.I rollen analyserar och kartlägger du patientens förmåga att utföra dagliga aktiviteter inom områdena personlig vård, boende, arbete, utbildning och fritid. I detta ingår bedömning av hur kroppsfunktioner såsom kognitiv förmåga, handens funktion och miljö påverkar aktivitetsutförandet. Rehabilitering innehåller åtgärder såsom träning, utbildning, kompensatoriska åtgärder i form av hjälpmedel, hjälpinsatser och miljöanpassning som syftar till att nå de mål som utformas tillsammans med patienten.KVALIFIKATIONERDu som söker är legitimerad arbetsterapeut med behörighet att verka inom svensk sjukvård. Språkkunskap i svenska lägst motsvarande nivå C1 enligt Europarådets nivåskala är ett krav. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av utredning och bedömning av neurologisk funktion och aktivitetsförmåga. Även erfarenhet av ICF-baserad verksamhet och interdisciplinärt teamarbete ses som meriterande. Vi ser gärna att du har intresse av arbetsterapeutisk metodutveckling i relation till patientklientelet.Som person trivs du med att arbeta patientfokuserat med en helhetssyn och ett vårdkedjeperspektiv. Du har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och under eget ansvar samtidigt som du samarbetar väl i team. Därtill har du en god pedagogisk förmåga och initiativförmåga. jobs.title: Steuerfachkraft für Digitalisierung & KI (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du kennst DATEV aus dem Kanzleialltag und weißt genau, wo Zeit verloren geht: doppelte Eingaben, Nacharbeit, Medienbrüche, unnötige Klickstrecken. Und du hast Lust, das nicht länger hinzunehmen, sondern zu ändern? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen eine Steuerfachkraft für Digitalisierung & KI (m/w/d) für die Nexus Gruppe in Hamburg.

Was macht die Nexus Gruppe?
Die Nexus Gruppe ist ein Kooperationsverbund eigenständiger Steuerberatungskanzleien in ganz Deutschland. Wir zentralisieren Aufgabenbereiche, die kleinere Kanzleien oftmals nicht vollumfänglich abbilden können: Personalgewinnung, Marketing sowie den Einsatz von KI-Anwendungen.

Deine Rolle
Du verbindest Kanzleipraxis, DATEV-Erfahrung und Prozessverständnis mit Interesse an KI und Automatisierung. Du stehst im ständigen Austausch mit unseren Partnerkanzleien, nimmst deren Abläufe auf und entwickelst daraus Standardprozesse für den Verbund.

Du musst selbst keine Software entwickeln. Die technische Umsetzung übernimmt unser Entwickler. Entscheidend ist, dass du Kanzleiprozesse fachlich verstehst und Anforderungen so beschreiben kannst, dass daraus funktionierende Lösungen entstehen. Wenn du Lust hast, selbst Automatisierungen zu bauen, zeigen wir dir die Werkzeuge dafür.

Deine Arbeit hat direkten Praxisbezug: Was ihr entwickelt, wird in den Partnerkanzleien eingesetzt, getestet und weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben

Was dich bei der Nexus Gruppe erwartet:

  • Du nimmst bestehende Prozesse in den Kanzleien auf und erkennst, welche Schritte sich durch KI oder Automatisierung sinnvoll unterstützen lassen.
  • Du entwickelst daraus Standardprozesse, die alle Kanzleien im Verbund nutzen können.
  • Du beschreibst fachliche Anforderungen so genau, dass unser Entwickler daraus Automatisierungen, KI-Assistenten und Workflows bauen kann.
  • Du sorgst mit deinem DATEV-Wissen dafür, dass die Lösungen im Kanzleialltag wirklich funktionieren.
  • Du testest neue Lösungen gemeinsam mit den Anwendern in den Kanzleien und bewertest Qualität, Verständlichkeit und Praxistauglichkeit.
  • Du holst Rückmeldungen aus den Kanzleien ein und leitest daraus die nächsten Entwicklungsschritte ab.
  • Du legst fest, wo beim Einsatz von KI fachliche Prüfung nötig bleibt und wo die Grenzen liegen.
  • Du begleitest Einführung, Dokumentation und Schulung in den Partnerkanzleien.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r, Steuerfachwirt/in, Bilanzbuchhalter/in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Auch ein anderer Hintergrund ist willkommen, wenn du die Abläufe in Steuerkanzleien aus mehrjähriger Praxis kennst.
  • Du kennst DATEV aus der täglichen Arbeit und verstehst, wie eine Kanzlei organisiert ist.
  • Du hast ein Gespür dafür, wo Nacharbeit, Medienbrüche oder Qualitätsrisiken entstehen.
  • Du interessierst dich für Digitalisierung, KI und Automatisierung und probierst neue Programme gern aus.
  • Du kannst Abläufe klar erklären und strukturiert beschreiben.

Benefits

  • Raus aus dem Fristendruck: Du arbeitest nicht mehr Mandate ab, sondern verbesserst die Abläufe, mit denen Kanzleien täglich arbeiten.
  • Intensive und persönliche Einarbeitung: Deine ersten Wochen sind darauf ausgelegt, dir sämtliche Werkzeuge und Kenntnisse an die Hand zu geben, die du für einen erfolgreichen Start benötigst.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust den Bereich KI & Automatisierung von Beginn an mit auf, mit kurzen Wegen zur Geschäftsführung.
  • Zentrales Office: Unser Büro liegt in Barmbek-Süd, perfekt angebunden an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr, mit eigenem Parkplatz.
  • Erstklassige Ausstattung: Höhenverstellbare Tische, MacBook Pro oder Air sowie hochwertiges Zubehör.
  • Team-Events: Top-Golf, After-Work-Partys oder Segeln auf der Alster: Es steht immer etwas an.
  • Vollstes Vertrauen: Du hast eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe und bekommst von Beginn an vollstes Vertrauen in deine Kompetenz und deine Meinung.
  • Erstklassige Büroausstattung: Neben höhenverstellbaren Tischen startest du bei uns mit einem MacBook Pro oder Air sowie hochwertigem Zubehör.

jobs.title: Vil du kombinere salg, kundekontakt og interesse for lastebilbransjen
jobs.description:
Den beste feilen er den som aldri oppstår. For kundene våre handler en lastebil om langt mer enn transport. Den skal starte hver dag, levere som planlagt og være på veien når kunden trenger den. Når service, kontroller eller nødvendige reparasjoner blir utsatt, kan det raskt føre til driftsstans og unødvendige kostnader.I Norsk Scania ønsker vi å være i forkant. Derfor ser vi nå etter en Account Manager, Rolling Fleet som vil bidra til å utvikle kundeoppfølgingen vår, identifisere nye salgsmuligheter og sørge for at kundene får mest mulig ut av kjøretøyene sine.Dette er en spennende mulighet for deg som trives med kundekontakt, motiveres av salg og liker å finne løsninger som skaper verdi for både kunden og Scania.Om rollenSom Account Manager Rolling Fleet får du en sentral rolle i oppfølgingen av våre eksisterende kunder og deres kjøretøy.Ved hjelp av kunde- og kjøretøydata skal du identifisere behov, se salgsmuligheter og tilby løsninger som bidrar til økt oppetid og en mer effektiv drift for kundene våre.Du vil ha tett dialog med kundene og samarbeide med våre verksteder, kundemottakere og salgsorganisasjonen for å sikre at behov blir fulgt opp og omgjort til konkrete salg og verkstedoppdrag.Dette er en spennende rolle for deg som vil kombinere salg, relasjonsbygging og interesse for transportbransjen.ArbeidsstedStillingen vil ha kontorsted ved et av våre Scania-anlegg på Østlandet. Vi er fleksible når det gjelder lokasjon, og endelig arbeidssted avtales i løpet av rekrutteringsprosessen.Hvem ser vi etter?Vi ser etter deg som trives med kundekontakt, er nysgjerrig på kundens behov og motiveres av å skape resultater.Vi tror du vil trives i rollen dersom du:
  • Liker å bruke telefonen som arbeidsverktøy og ta initiativ til kundedialog.
  • Har interesse for lastebiler, transportbransjen og kundens drift.
  • Er god til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit.
  • Har et kommersielt blikk og ser muligheter for mersalg.
  • Jobber strukturert og samarbeider godt med andre.
  • Har konkurranseinstinkt og motiveres av å nå mål.
Du har gjerne erfaring fra salg, kundeservice, verksted eller transportbransjen. Relevant utdanning er positivt, men ikke avgjørende.For oss er motivasjonen din, evnen til å skape gode kunderelasjoner og viljen til å lære minst like viktig som hva som står på CV-en.Hva kan vi tilby deg?Hos Norsk Scania blir du en del av et solid, internasjonalt selskap med dyktige kolleger og et stort engasjement for både kunder og medarbeidere.Vi tilbyr deg:
  • En spennende og variert rolle med mulighet til å påvirke kundeopplevelsen og salgsresultatene.
  • Muligheten til å bidra til å utvikle vår kundeoppfølging.
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og kompetente kolleger.
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.
  • Årlige sosiale sammenkomster og aktiviteter som skaper samhold og trivsel.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
Klar for å bli en del av Scania?Vi ser etter deg som ikke bare ser en lastebil, men også mulighetene som ligger i å holde den på veien.Hos oss får du bruke din kommersielle teft, bygge sterke kunderelasjoner og bidra til løsninger som gjør en forskjell for kundene våre.Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad!Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte Christoffer Hermann, regionsdirektør for Region Øst Nord, på telefon 993 32 778.Søknadsfrist: Onsdag 9. desember 2026.Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

jobs.title: Responsable Régional Eolien F/H - CDI - Bordeaux
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ? 

 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

 

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

 

Vos missions : 

Rattaché.e au Directeur Eolien Adjoint, vous êtes chargé.e du développement d’un portefeuille de projets éoliens, de l'animation, de la coordination et de l'encadrement hiérarchique d’une équipe projets. 

 
Vos missions seront les suivantes : 

  • Encadrement hiérarchique des membres de l’équipe projets 
  • Pilotage depuis la prospection jusqu’à la pré construction du portefeuille de projets éoliens sur la Région Nouvelle-Aquitaine 
  • Garant de la bonne gestion de ses projets en termes de Qualité, Coûts et Délais 
  • Coordination de l’activité et notamment mise en place et respect des méthodologies, procédures et gestion de la charge de travail des équipes Projets 
  • Etablissement et suivi des objectifs de développement et des indicateurs de performance de son portefeuille 
  • Suivi du développement des projets, conseil et expertise auprès des équipes projets 
  • Supervision de la préparation des dossiers d’appel à propositions 
  • Suivi et préparation du reporting mensuel de sa région 
  • Animation des équipes et contribution au développement des compétences et du partage des connaissances 
  • Soutien, accompagnement et formation, plus particulièrement lors de phases critiques du développement des projets, réunions publiques, visites de sites, élus, services de l’état, etc. 
  • Participation à des réunions et des actions de lobbying et de développement du réseau de partenaires 
  • Travail en mode projet et assure la bonne animation des revues des projets 
  • Participation à des initiatives d’amélioration continue de l’entreprise 
  • Implication auprès des associations professionnelles de la filière (SER, France Renouvelables...) 
  • Et toutes autres activités liées au développement des projets de la société.

HSE : 

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :  

 

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides 
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement  
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques 

 

 

Qualité : 

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité  
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité  
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives 
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs 

 

Requirements

Votre profil : 

De formation d’Ingénieur ou Bac + 5, aménagement du territoire, géographie ou immobilier vous avez une expérience professionnelle justifiée de résultats concrets dans la gestion de projets.  

La connaissance du domaine de l’éolien et/ou de l’énergie est nécessaire (expérience souhaitée de 5 ans). Vous avez pu intervenir sur toutes les phases clefs du développement de projets. 

Une expérience managériale réussie est indispensable. 

Bon communiquant.e, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et les relations avec des acteurs externes. 

Pugnace et autonome, vous avez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles. Vous disposez d’une intelligence situationnelle et vous adhérez aux valeurs de l’entreprise. 

Rigoureux.se, vous savez gérer vos priorités grâce à de réelles capacités d’analyses. 

Le poste requiert un excellent rédactionnel en français. Un anglais professionnel est souhaité. 

 

Ce poste est basé à Bordeaux et nécessite de nombreux déplacements (permis B obligatoire).

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ? 

 

  • Des valeurs fortes et incarnées   
  • Un management de proximité   
  • Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante   
  • Valorisation et développement des compétences   

 

 

Nos avantages sociaux :

 

  • Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires 

 

  • 4 jours de congés par an offerts pour des actions de bénévolat    

 

  • L’abondement de vos dons aux associations à hauteur de 500€ par an    

 

  • Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité   

 

  • Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société)   

 

  • Activités et évènements régulièrement proposés par le CSE   

 

  • Très bonne couverture mutuelle (famille incluse) et Prévoyance    

 

Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives. 

Convaincu.e.s que la diversité est une richesse, nous veillons à offrir un processus de recrutement accessible et équitable. A compétences égales, toutes les candidatures sont étudiées avec la même attention. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement lors du recrutement, n'hésitez pas à nous en faire part, notre référente handicap pourra vous accompagner en toute confidentialité.

jobs.title: Level Design - Puzzle (Turkish Speaker)
jobs.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The team

You join an 8-person puzzle studio in Istanbul, founded by Peak and Zynga alumni. It's backed by Homa's puzzle, data, art, and UA teams. Its new puzzle game is heading to global launch, and fresh levels are now its biggest growth lever.

The opportunity

You own the levels players see every week. You work every day with Homa's product director and the studio's level designers, artists, and engineers. You use a level editor and AI tools that generate layouts and estimate difficulty. AI makes you faster, and you stay the brain behind every level. You work remotely from Türkiye. The team is small, and the bar is high.

As the studio grows, you can own a family of mechanics or a pack of levels. You can also lead a group of level designers, or move toward a product role.

Your responsibilities

  • Build. Your levels keep fresh content reaching players, every single week.
  • Tune. Your difficulty curve makes levels feel hard but fair, so players keep trying.
  • Introduce. New mechanics land smoothly because your levels teach them step by step.
  • Test. You play every level before release, so players only see levels that work.
  • Optimize. You use win rate, attempts and churn data to turn weak live levels into strong ones.
  • Shape. Your ideas on new mechanics and content push the game forward.
  • Accelerate. You use AI to generate layout variants, explore difficulty options and check solvability.

What we look for

  • Ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don't wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
  • AI-driven. AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly.
  • Motivated. You're ambitious and grounded. You see this opportunity as a chance to learn faster than anywhere else.

Requirements

  • Experience. 1+ year in level design, game design or QA on mobile games, ideally puzzle games.
  • Languages. Fluent Turkish and English. You use both every day.
  • Volume with quality. You ship every week and never let quality slip.
  • Tool speed. You work fast in a level editor and pick up new tools quickly.
  • Data sense. You track level data and use it to tune your levels.
  • Puzzle instinct. You play puzzle games a lot and can explain why a level works.
  • AI native. You turn AI into output. You've built tools that generate layouts, check solvability or analyse level data.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Shipped levels on a live mobile puzzle game.
  • Experience with Unity or a similar game engine.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Our process (2 weeks max)

  • Call with our recruiter (30 min). A generalized conversation, and to tell you more about the role.
  • Level design case study. We look at your thinking and your technical skills.
  • Technical interview with the studio's level designers to dive deeper into technicalities.
  • Final interview with the studio founder and Homa's Puzzle lead. Focused on motivation, values, and fit.

Benefits

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest. Your scope and your rewards grow with what you deliver, not with tenure.
  • Real ownership. No layers between you and the result. You own outcomes, not tasks, whatever your level.
  • Direct impact. Your work moves the business and shapes where Homa goes next. Decisions are made fast, and you see the results in the numbers.
  • AI at the core. With access to the best AI tools, you'll help shape how an AI-first company works, and your time goes where your judgment matters most.
  • High talent bar. Our teams are small, with people from the best companies, and the talent around you will push you to grow.

What we offer

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here's what you can expect:

  • Comprehensive benefits. Depending on where you're based, you'll get perks such as health insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym membership, and more.
  • A brand-new Paris HQ. A desk in our new office in the heart of Paris, whenever you want to work side by side with the team.
  • An international team. Work in English with top talent from 35+ countries across Europe, the UK, the US, and beyond. Our diversity fuels our creativity.
  • Team gatherings. We value time together beyond the screen. Join regular team gatherings and off-site retreats to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • Performance reviews. Every six months, we look back at your progress, recognise your wins, and agree on clear goals for what's next.
  • Equipment support. From day one, you get everything you need to do your best work, including a home office allowance if you work remotely.

Where we hire

Our Paris HQ is a lively hub for creativity, collaboration, and connection. From lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, it's a space people genuinely enjoy, in our brand-new office in the heart of Paris (awesome energy and snacks included).

We also have great teammates across Europe, from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you work from home in Barcelona or Warsaw, you're fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we mainly hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there, or planning to be, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ?KWARTIER est une société luxembourgeoise spécialisée dans l'investissement, la gestion et le développement immobilier. Nous accompagnons principalement des investisseurs privés et des structures patrimoniales dans la constitution, la gestion, l'optimisation et la valorisation de leur patrimoine immobilier au Luxembourg. Notre philosophie est simple : nous gérons les biens de nos clients comme s'il s'agissait de nos propres biens. Cela implique une attention particulier/ière à la préservation de leur valeur, à l'optimisation de leur rendement, à la maîtrise des coûts et à la qualité de leur entretien sur le long terme. Notre approche repose sur un accompagnement personnalisé, une grande disponibilité, une discrétion absolue et une relation de confiance avec nos clients. Nous ne nous limitons pas à la gestion quotidien/ienne des propriétés : nous cherchons également à anticiper les besoins, identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et conseiller nos clients dans leurs décisions patrimoniales. Nos activités s'articulent autour de trois pôles complémentaires :-   La gestion immobilier/ière et l'optimisation de portefeuilles : gestion administrative, technique et locative de biens immobiliers appartenant à différents propriétaires, avec une attention particulier/ière portée à leur rentabilité, leur entretien et leur valorisation. -   La promotion immobilier/ière : identification d'opportunités d'investissement, développement et réalisation de projets immobiliers, notamment résidentiels. -   La construction et la rénovation : à travers notre société AMAK Construction S.à r.l., nous réalisons et coordonnons des projets de construction, de transformation et de rénovation immobilier/ière.Cette complémentarité nous permet d'intervenir à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie d'un bien immobilier, de son acquisition à sa gestion, son développement et son éventuelle revente. Le posteDans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un(e) gestionnaire immobilier polyvalent(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe basée à Luxembourg-Ville. Le poste sera principalement consacré à la gestion et à l'optimisation des portefeuilles de nos clients, en assurant un service de qualité à nos propriétaires et locataires. Les missions comprendront notamment :-   Gestion quotidien/ienne des biens : être l'interlocuteur des propriétaires, locataires et prestataires, traiter les demandes et trouver des solutions aux problèmes rencontrés.-   Suivi technique et coordination des interventions : organiser les réparations, travaux d'entretien et interventions des différents corps de métier, demander et comparer des devis, suivre leur bonne exécution.-   Gestion locative : organiser les visites, assurer le suivi des candidatures, participer à la préparation des contrats de bail, coordonner les entrées et sorties des locataires et les états des lieux.-   Optimisation et valorisation du portefeuille : identifier les possibilités d'amélioration des biens, contribuer à l'optimisation des revenus locatifs, à la maîtrise des charges et à la préservation de la valeur des actifs à long terme.-   Suivi administratif : assurer le suivi des dossiers immobiliers, des contrats, des factures et des différentes démarches administratives.-   Relation client : maintenir une communication régulier/ière et professionnelle avec les propriétaires et locataires, dans un esprit de disponibilité, de discrétion et de recherche de solutions.Nous attachons une importance particulier/ière à une gestion proactive. Il s'agit d'anticiper les problèmes plutôt que de simplement y réagir, et de gérer chaque propriété avec le même soin, le même bon sens économique et le même niveau d'exigence que si elle nous appartenait. Un poste varié et évolutifSi la gestion immobilier/ière constitue le cœur du poste, la diversité de nos activités offre également la possibilité de s'impliquer progressivement dans d'autres domaines, notamment la promotion immobilier/ière et la construction. Au sein de notre structure à taille humaine, les responsabilités peuvent évoluer en fonction des compétences, des intérêts et de l'engagement de chacun. Le profil recherchéNous recherchons avant tout une personne autonome, débrouillarde, organisée et polyvalent(e), qui aime prendre des initiatives et trouver des solutions concrètes. Le/la candidat(e) idéal(e) devra notamment :-   Avoir un bon sens du contact et apprécier les relations humaines, aussi bien avec les clients qu'avec les locataires et les professionnels du bâtiment.-   Être organisé, rigoureux et capable de gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément.-   Faire preuve de bon sens pratique, de réactivité, d'initiative et d'un réel sens des responsabilités.-   Être à l'aise avec les tâches administratives tout en appréciant le travail...

Čo vám ponúkame?•    Inšpiratívne prostredie moderného a kreatívneho módneho ateliéru.•    Práca na jedinečných projektoch, žiadna stereotypná pásová výroba.•    Prístup k najnovším módnym trendom a exkluzívnym materiálom.•    Flexibilný pracovný čas (podľa dohody).•    Motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie závislé od vašich skúseností a kvality odvedenej práce.•    Zamestnanecká zľava na modely z našej dielne.Miesto výkonu práce: Rimavská SobotaDruh pracovného pomeru: TPP / Skrátený úväzokMzdové podmienky: Dohodou (v závislosti od skúseností)

jobs.title: sales director
jobs.description: Construction Sales Representative Closer NO31 Hantverk, Stockholm. About NO31 Hantverk. NO31 Hantverk is a growing construction and renovation company focused on delivering professional renovation, property maintenance and construction services to private customers, property owners and businesses. We are looking for a commercially driven salesperson who can help turn qualified customer inquiries into profitable projects and contribute to the company's continued growth. Position: Construction Sales Representative / Closer. Location: Stockholm, Sweden. Work arrangement: Hybrid remote administration combined with customer visits and field inspections. Employment structure: Initially performance-based, with the possibility of a longer-term arrangement as the business grows. Responsibilities. As our construction sales representative, you will be responsible for managing the sales process from the first customer contact until a contract is signed. Your responsibilities include contacting and following up on incoming qualified leads, booking and attending customer appointments, conducting site visits with technical experts, understanding customer requirements and expectations, presenting suitable renovation solutions, coordinating quotations with the estimation team, negotiating and closing contracts, maintaining customer relationships, and following up on outstanding quotations. Candidate profile. We're looking for someone who has preferably at least two years of experience in construction sales, renovation, property services, or B2B sales; understands the Swedish construction and renovation market; has strong communication and negotiation skills; is confident meeting customers in the field; can independently manage sales opportunities; is commercially minded and motivated by results and business development; and speaks and writes Swedish fluently. What we offer: opportunity to be part of a growing construction business, flexible working arrangements, performance-based compensation, access to an established lead-generation infrastructure, technical support, and opportunities for increased responsibility as the company expands. Compensation will be commission-based, linked to successfully closed and collected business, with commission structured around project profitability rather than total contract value. Application: Interested candidates are welcome to submit their CV and a short introduction outlining their relevant sales experience.

jobs.title: Čašníci a someliéri
jobs.description:
V Strachan Resorte v Ždiari nespájame len tradičnú goralskú pohostinnosť s prémiovou kvalitou, ale vytvárame pre našich hostí zážitky. Naša reštaurácia je známa skvelou gastronómiou, rodinnou atmosférou a dychberúcimi výhľadmi na Belianske Tatry. Hľadáme do nášho tímu profesionála, pre ktorého nie je gastronómia len prácou, ale srdcovou záležitosťou.

Náplň práce:

Profesionálna a ústretová obsluha hostí v reštaurácii.

Aktívny predaj našich špecialít, prémiových vín a destilátov (radi ťa do všetkého zasvätíme).

Prestieranie stolov, udržiavanie čistoty a poriadku na rajóne.

Práca s pokladničným systémom a hotovosťou/terminálom.

Komunikácia s kuchyňou s cieľom zabezpečiť plynulý servis.

Reprezentovanie dobrého mena Strachan Resortu úsmevom a proaktívnym prístupom.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Kuchári (okrem šéfkuchárov)
jobs.description:
Hľadáme šikovného a spoľahlivého kuchára/kuchárku s vášňou pre gastronómiu, ktorý/á by chcel/a pôsobiť v úspešnom tíme reštaurácie Medvedí brloh. Reštaurácia sa nachádza priamo pod svahom Ski Centra Strachan v Ždiari, v malebnom prostredí pod hrebeňom Belianskych Tatier, v celodrevenej stavbe s prvkami pôvodnej goralskej architektúry a s terasou s výhľadom na okolité končiare. Cez deň je Medvedí brloh obľúbeným miestom na dobré jedlo, večer sa však mení na miesto veľkej zábavy, pravidelne tu organizujeme akcie so známymi DJmi.

Čo u nás budete robiť:

Príprava a výdaj jedál podľa jedálneho lístka, ktorý spája tradičné slovenské špeciality (halušky, pirohy) s modernými jedlami ako domáce burgre či pizza

Príprava sezónnych a regionálnych špecialít z kvalitných surovín

Práca v tíme profesionálnych kuchárov pod vedením skúseného šéfkuchára.

Pracovná doba:

Pracovné zmeny: krátky/dlhý týždeň alebo podľa dohody

Ak vás baví varenie, dobrá atmosféra a chcete byť súčasťou tímu obľúbenej reštaurácie priamo pod svahom, kde sa cez deň varí a večer tancuje, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Management & Personal Assistant
jobs.description:
A packed schedule, a hundred things happening at once and always something that needs sorting out. Sound familiar?

Some people find that stressful. You actually thrive on it!

As Management & Personal Assistant, you'll become a trusted right hand to management, providing both professional and personal support.

But here's what really makes the difference: you don't just get things started, you make sure they're properly taken care of, right down to the smallest detail.

You'll be trusted to take ownership, anticipate needs and find solutions independently, without constant reminders or follow-ups.

The goal? To give management the peace of mind that when something is in your hands, it's taken care of.

No two days are quite the same. And that's exactly what makes this role so interesting!

Your responsibilities cover two main areas.

Management Support – Making things happen behind the scenes

  • You manage inboxes, calendars and daily communications, ensuring everything is followed up efficiently.
  • You organise and prepare meetings, appointments and discussions.
  • You gather information, bring structure and create clear, practical overviews.
  • You keep track of deadlines, action points and ongoing projects.
  • You provide administrative and organisational support across various management responsibilities, including sales and HR.
  • You liaise with colleagues, suppliers and external partners.
  • You assist with the practical organisation of business trips, trade fairs, reservations and events.
  • When management is away, you keep things moving. You follow up on important matters, handle what you can independently and provide a clear overview upon their return.

Personal & Household Management – Making life easier!

Beyond business support, you'll also help keep the personal lives of the management team running smoothly.

This isn't a housekeeping position. It's about coordinating, organising and taking care of practical matters that make everyday life easier.

  • You coordinate external household help and manage the related planning and communication.
  • You arrange home maintenance, repairs, deliveries and appointments.
  • You handle practical errands and purchases for both the company and private needs.
  • You manage orders, parcels, deliveries and returns.
  • You organise gifts, flowers and thoughtful gestures.
  • You research and coordinate private travel, appointments and reservations.
  • You take care of practical arrangements involving vehicles, servicing and other everyday matters.

And sometimes, something unexpected simply needs sorting out.

No problem. You focus on solutions, not obstacles!

An impressive CV? Great! But for this position, who you are and how you work matter just as much as what you've already accomplished.

We're looking for someone who's naturally organised. Not because they've learned to be, but because it's simply part of who they are. Someone who notices the little things, thinks ahead and genuinely enjoys bringing order to a busy day.

Does this sound like you?

  • Organisation is second nature to you. You love structure, have an exceptional eye for detail and never lose sight of the bigger picture.
  • You're always thinking a few steps ahead. You spot what needs doing, take initiative and don't wait for instructions.
  • You take real ownership. When something is entrusted to you, others can count on it being handled from start to finish, without having to double-check.
  • Discretion comes naturally. You're trustworthy, reliable and understand the importance of confidentiality when professional and personal matters overlap.
  • You're hands-on, flexible and solution-oriented. You switch easily between different responsibilities and stay calm when unexpected situations arise.
  • You're a confident communicator and digitally savvy. You communicate clearly, feel comfortable with digital tools and adapt easily to different situations.
  • You genuinely enjoy making life easier for others. Knowing that someone can stop worrying about something because you've taken care of it? That's what motivates you!

What else do you bring?

  • A bachelor's degree and ideally some initial experience in an administrative, organisational or support role.
  • Previous experience in a similar position is a definite advantage, but the right attitude, maturity and potential to grow into the role are just as valuable.
  • Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken, ideally together with good written French.
  • A valid category B driving licence.

And the right personal fit? That's just as important to us.

You feel at home in a dynamic, informal environment with a relatively young team. You're positive, engaged and bring a healthy dose of common sense.

Ultimately, we're looking for someone management can turn to and say: "Could you take care of this?" And know it's in good hands.

jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Fund Operations Specialist (Alternative Investments) 80-100%--- Fund Operations Specialist (Alternative Investments) 80\-100%=============================================================**About PG3**PG3 AG is the family office of the Partners Group founders and was established in 2013\. As a FINMA regulated asset manager, we manage a range of niche investment strategies for our founders and investors. We focus on uncorrelated returns which ensure material diversification both in terms of underlying sectors and investment structures. **About the role**PG3 AG is looking for a **Fund Operations Specialist (Alternative Investments)**to join our Fund Operations team in Baar, ZG (Switzerland), on an 80\-100% basis. In this role, you will take ownership of the accounting and fund administration of a diverse portfolio of investment products throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include supporting fund launches, restructurings and wind\-downs, as well as overseeing ongoing accounting, NAV preparation, financial reporting and operational monitoring. You will work closely with internal teams and external service providers to ensure accurate seamless execution and high stakeholder satisfaction. The Fund Operations team manages a broad mandate across alternative (insurance finance, legal finance, royalty finance) and traditional asset classes, including equities and credit. You will be part of a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment, contributing to both strategic and operational initiatives. Key Responsibilities: * Support day\-to\-day financial administration and accounting of investment funds and related entities including all fund transactions (subscriptions, redemptions, capital calls, distributions, loans and FX transactions).* Review and reconcile quarterly NAV calculations, including cash balances, investment positions, financial transactions and management and performance fee calculations.* Coordinate with external fund administrators, AIFMs, custodians, banks, auditors and other service providers in reconciling portfolio and cash flows of investment positions.* Monitor fund liquidity, cash flows, loans and settlement processes.* Maintain accurate fund records, transaction documentation, and operational databases.* Coordinate annual auditsand liaise with external auditors, fund administrators, and other service providers on accounting\-related matters, providing supporting documentation.* Assist with new fund launches, restructurings, investments, disposals and liquidations.* Support the onboarding and ongoing administration of investors, assisting with periodic KYC refreshes, FATCA/CRS reporting and other compliance\-related information requests.* Execution of investment reporting with precision and timeliness* Provide support across our middle\- and back\-office functions.* Application of regulatory and legal knowledge in daily operations **About you**We are looking for a proactive, detail\-oriented self\-starter who thrives in a dynamic and multicultural environment. You should be motivated by high standards, eager to take ownership, and comfortable navigating complexity. Ideally, you bring: * University degree (or equivalent qualification) in business administration, finance or economics* At least 2 years of relevant experience in fund accounting, fund administration, asset management, accounting or financial advisory* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities within tight deadlines* A collaborative mindset with a willingness to go the extra mile* Exhibit accuracy, efficiency, independence, and a strong sense of responsibility* Excellent communication skills in English ( is a plus)* A keen interest in alternative investments and exposure to the full investment lifecycle Please submit your complete application, including a CV, cover letter, relevant certificates, and references. ![PG3 AG]()* PG3 AG  Unternehmer\- 3  6340 Baar*jid83909c0jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Senior Patent Counsel
jobs.description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Senior Patent Counsel --- Senior Patent Counsel ===================== Established in 1927, SICPA is a Swiss private technology company that supports the effective governance and long\\-term prosperity of nations. SICPA sets \*the pulse of sovereignty\*, enabling governments to protect their citizens, sovereign assets, and economies. Best known for securing the majority of the world's banknotes, SICPA operates across five continents. Today, our platform for sovereignty delivers integrated solutions safeguarding revenue mobilisation, natural resources, health, and brand protection as well as digital sovereignty and secure public services. The primary objective of this role is to ensure that technology identification, extraction and protection are aligned with the business activities in the field of chemistry. A strong understanding of the underlying technologies and their commercial applications is therefore essential to success in this position. The in\\-house Patent Attorney will act as a hands\\-on partner to the business, advising on day\\-to\\-day business development opportunities and ensuring that new innovations are effectively identified and protected through patents. Working closely with the Research \\\& Innovation (R\\\&I) team and the IP department, the role will focus on innovation extraction, patent drafting and prosecution. Ingénieur Systèmes Microsoft – Core Engineering (L2/L3\)
============================================================

### Qui sommes\-nous ?

INGINIA est un intégrateur suisse spécialisé dans les infrastructures IT, le Cloud et la cybersécurité.

Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la transformation, la modernisation et l'exploitation de leurs systèmes d'information, à travers cinq domaines d'expertise :

* Managed Services
* Data Center \& Infrastructure
* Cloud
* Cybersecurity
* Consulting \& Audits


Entreprise à taille humaine, nous privilégions l'expertise technique, la proximité avec nos clients et la qualité des services délivrés.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de Services Managés, nous recherchons plusieurs nouveaux talents pour renforcer notre équipe **Core Engineering**.

### Votre mission

En tant qu'Ingénieur Systèmes Microsoft, vous intégrez notre équipe Core Engineering et intervenez sur des infrastructures critiques et des environnements clients variés.

Votre rôle couvre deux domaines complémentaires :

**BUILD – Projets et intégration**

* Participer à la conception et à la réalisation de projets d'infrastructure Microsoft.
* Déployer, configurer et migrer des environnements Windows Server, Active Directory et Microsoft 365\.
* Réaliser des projets de virtualisation, de consolidation et de modernisation des infrastructures.
* Participer aux évolutions d'architecture et aux migrations de plateformes.
* Assurer la mise en production, les tests de validation et la documentation technique.
* Garantir une transition structurée des projets vers les équipes d'exploitation.


**RUN – Exploitation et support avancé L2/L3**

* Assurer le support technique avancé sur les infrastructures de nos clients.
* Prendre en charge les incidents complexes escaladés par le ServiceDesk et l'Operations Control.
* Diagnostiquer les dysfonctionnements, identifier leurs causes racines et mettre en œuvre des solutions durables.
* Réaliser les opérations de maintenance, de patching et les changements d'infrastructure.
* Participer à l'amélioration de la disponibilité, des performances et de la sécurité des environnements.
* Contribuer à la standardisation des infrastructures et à l'amélioration continue de nos services.
* Maintenir une documentation technique rigoureuse et partager vos connaissances avec les autres équipes.


### Votre profil

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur, d'un Bachelor en informatique, d'un CFC d'informaticien ou d'une formation équivalente.

Vous justifiez idéalement d'au moins **3 à 5 ans d'expérience** dans l'administration et l'ingénierie de systèmes Microsoft, avec une expérience significative dans des environnements de production.

Vous appréciez autant la réalisation de projets techniques que la résolution d'incidents complexes.

Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux et capable d'intervenir sur des infrastructures critiques, tout en privilégiant le travail d'équipe et la satisfaction client.

### Vos compétences techniques

**Environnement Microsoft – Compétences essentielles**

* Excellente maîtrise de Windows Server et de ses principaux rôles et services.
* Administration et troubleshooting Active Directory (AD DS), GPO, DNS et DHCP.
* Bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Entra ID, des identités hybrides et des mécanismes d'authentification.
* Connaissance des infrastructures PKI, des certificats et des services RADIUS/NPS.
* Administration de Microsoft 365 et des environnements hybrides.
* Connaissances d'Exchange Online et des mécanismes de messagerie.
* Administration et maintenance de bases de données Microsoft SQL Server : installation, configuration, sauvegardes, restauration et notions de performance.
* Bonnes connaissances de PowerShell pour l'administration et l'automatisation des tâches.


**Virtualisation et infrastructures Datacenter**

* Expérience pratique sur au moins une des plateformes de virtualisation suivantes :VMware vSphere / ESXi / Proxmox VE / Vates XCP\-ng / Xen Orchestra/ Huawei DCS / Microsoft Hyper\-V
* Compréhension des architectures de virtualisation, de haute disponibilité et de stockage partagé.
* Expérience des migrations de machines virtuelles et des évolutions de plateformes.
* Connaissance des technologies de stockage SAN/NAS et des protocoles iSCSI, NFS et Fibre Channel.


**Citrix – Virtualisation des postes et applications**

* Connaissance des environnements Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops.
* Compréhension des architectures VDI et VDA (Virtual Desktop / Virtual Desktop\&App).
* Administration et troubleshooting des infrastructures Citrix.
* Connaissance des composants Delivery Controller, StoreFront, VDA et des mécanismes de publication des applications et desktops.


**Sauvegarde, disponibilité et sécurité**

* Bonne compréhension des stratégies de sauvegarde et de restauration des systèmes.
* Expérience avec des solutions de sauvegarde telles que Veeam, Vinchin ou équivalentes.
* Connaissance des mécanismes de haute disponibilité et de Disaster Recovery.
* Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de sécurisation et de durcissement des environnements Windows.
* Compréhension des principes de gestion des vulnérabilités, de patch management et de protection des identités.


**Réseaux – Connaissances transversales**

* Bonne compréhension des protocoles TCP/IP, VLAN, routage, DNS et DHCP.
* Capacité à diagnostiquer des problèmes de connectivité réseau.
* Connaissance des principes de firewalling, VPN et segmentation réseau.


Une expertise avancée en routing/switching n'est pas requise pour ce poste.

### Compétences complémentaires appréciées

Les expériences suivantes constituent des atouts supplémentaires :

* Microsoft Azure et architectures hybrides.
* Microsoft Intune et gestion des postes de travail.
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint et solutions de sécurité Microsoft.
* Automatisation par PowerShell, scripting ou Infrastructure as Code.
* Supervision et monitoring des infrastructures.
* Expérience dans un environnement MSP (Managed Services Provider) ou chez un intégrateur IT.
* Participation à des projets de migration d'infrastructures ou de consolidation de Datacenters.
* Certifications Microsoft, VMware, Citrix ou équivalentes.


### Vos qualités personnelles

Au\-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons avant tout un collaborateur fiable, engagé et appréciant le travail collectif.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les qualités suivantes :

* **Autonomie et responsabilité :** vous savez prendre en charge une problématique technique et la mener jusqu'à sa résolution.
* **Esprit d'analyse :** vous cherchez à comprendre les causes des incidents plutôt qu'à simplement en traiter les symptômes.
* **Rigueur :** vous accordez de l'importance à la qualité des interventions, à la documentation et au respect des procédures.
* **Esprit d'équipe :** vous partagez vos connaissances et contribuez à la progression collective.
* **Orientation client :** vous êtes à l'aise dans les échanges avec les clients et savez communiquer clairement sur des sujets techniques.
* **Stabilité et gestion des priorités :** vous savez garder votre calme et travailler méthodiquement, même dans des situations exigeantes.
* **Curiosité technique :** vous aimez apprendre et découvrir de nouvelles technologies.


Vous maîtrisez le français et disposez d'un bon niveau d'anglais technique, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

### Ce que nous vous offrons

* Une activité technique variée, associant projets d'infrastructure et exploitation avancée.
* Des environnements clients diversifiés et des technologies de pointe.
* Une entreprise suisse à taille humaine, où vos compétences et vos propositions sont réellement prises en considération.
* Une collaboration directe avec des ingénieurs expérimentés et notre direction technique.
* Une organisation privilégiant l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la confiance.
* Des possibilités de formation, de certification et d'évolution professionnelle.
* L'opportunité de participer activement à l'évolution de nos offres et de nos standards techniques.


### Conditions de candidature

Vous êtes autorisé à travailler en Suisse et disposez d'un permis de conduire valable.

Vous êtes disponible pour des déplacements ponctuels auprès de nos clients, principalement en Suisse romande.

Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier de candidature comprenant votre CV, vos diplômes et vos certificats de travail.

**Rejoignez INGINIA et contribuez à construire, exploiter et faire évoluer les infrastructures IT de nos clients.**

![INGINIA SA]( )

* INGINIA SA  
Rue Pré de la Fontaine 19  
1242 Satigny
