Project Manager IT – Infrastructure \& Cloud
==============================================

### Qui sommes\-nous ?

INGINIA est un intégrateur suisse spécialisé dans les infrastructures IT, le Cloud et la cybersécurité.

Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la transformation, la modernisation et l'exploitation de leurs systèmes d'information, à travers cinq domaines d'expertise :

* Managed Services
* Data Center \& Infrastructure
* Cloud
* Cybersecurity
* Consulting \& Audits


Entreprise à taille humaine, nous privilégions l'expertise technique, la proximité avec nos clients et la qualité des services délivrés.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un **Project Manager IT** pour piloter nos projets d'infrastructure et accompagner nos clients dans leurs transformations technologiques.

### Votre mission

En tant que Project Manager IT, vous êtes responsable de la planification, de la coordination et de la bonne exécution des projets confiés à INGINIA.

Vous intervenez sur des projets variés : déploiement d'infrastructures Datacenter, modernisation des environnements IT, migrations Cloud, virtualisation, réseaux et cybersécurité.

Véritable chef d'orchestre, vous assurez la coordination entre nos clients, nos équipes d'ingénierie, nos partenaires technologiques et notre direction.

**Votre objectif : livrer des projets de qualité, dans les délais et les budgets convenus, tout en garantissant la satisfaction de nos clients et la rentabilité des prestations.**

### Vos responsabilités

**Gestion et pilotage des projets**

* Prendre en charge les projets dès leur lancement et jusqu'à leur clôture.
* Définir les périmètres, livrables, plannings, budgets et jalons.
* Élaborer et maintenir les plans projets et tableaux de bord.
* Identifier les risques, anticiper les difficultés et proposer des mesures correctives.
* Assurer le suivi régulier de l'avancement et le respect des engagements contractuels.
* Piloter plusieurs projets simultanément en maintenant une vision claire des priorités.
* Organiser les phases de recette, de validation et de clôture des projets.


**Coordination des ressources et des équipes techniques**

* Coordonner les interventions des ingénieurs et des partenaires externes.
* Définir les besoins en ressources en collaboration avec la Direction Opérationnelle.
* Organiser et suivre les activités techniques nécessaires à la réalisation des projets.
* Veiller au respect des standards techniques et des processus internes.
* Collaborer avec le CTO pour les choix d'architecture et les validations techniques.
* Garantir une transmission structurée des environnements livrés vers les équipes de Services Managés (Build to Run).


**Relation client et communication**

* Être l'interlocuteur principal du client durant toutes les phases du projet.
* Organiser et animer les séances de lancement, de coordination et de suivi.
* Rédiger les procès\-verbaux, comptes rendus et rapports d'avancement.
* Communiquer de manière transparente et proactive sur les délais, les risques et les éventuelles difficultés.
* Gérer les attentes des clients et maîtriser les évolutions du périmètre contractuel.
* Entretenir une relation de confiance avec les interlocuteurs techniques et décisionnels.


**Suivi financier et rentabilité**

* Assurer le suivi des budgets, des coûts et des marges de chaque projet.
* Contrôler les heures consommées et les comparer aux estimations initiales.
* Identifier rapidement les écarts budgétaires et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.
* Gérer les demandes de changement de périmètre et leurs impacts financiers.
* Collaborer avec l'administration pour le suivi de la facturation et des jalons contractuels.
* Produire un reporting financier régulier à destination de la direction.


**Qualité et amélioration continue**

* Garantir la qualité et l'exhaustivité de la documentation projet.
* Participer à l'amélioration des méthodes et outils de gestion de projets.
* Organiser les retours d'expérience et identifier les axes d'amélioration.
* Contribuer à la standardisation des pratiques et au partage des connaissances.
* Appliquer les principes de gouvernance et les processus internes d'INGINIA.


### Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une formation supérieure en informatique, en ingénierie ou d'une formation équivalente.

Vous justifiez d'au moins **3 à 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de projets IT**, idéalement acquise chez un intégrateur, une société de services informatiques ou un Managed Services Provider (MSP).

Vous avez déjà piloté des projets d'infrastructure impliquant plusieurs équipes techniques, des contraintes de production et des engagements contractuels.

Vous comprenez les enjeux techniques, financiers et organisationnels des projets informatiques.

Vous êtes capable de piloter un projet de manière autonome, de prendre des décisions et de maintenir une communication efficace avec l'ensemble des intervenants.

### Vos compétences

**Gestion de projets – Compétences essentielles**

* Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de projets d'infrastructure IT.
* Maîtrise des méthodes de gestion de projets traditionnelles, Agile ou hybrides.
* Excellentes capacités de planification, de coordination et de suivi.
* Expérience dans la gestion des budgets, des coûts et des marges.
* Maîtrise de la gestion des risques et des changements de périmètre.
* Capacité à produire des reportings structurés et des indicateurs de performance (KPI).
* Bonne maîtrise des outils de gestion de projets et de la suite Microsoft 365\.


**Connaissances techniques – Infrastructure IT**

Une solide compréhension des environnements suivants est attendue :

* Infrastructures Datacenter, serveurs et stockage.
* Virtualisation : VMware, Proxmox, Vates XCP\-ng ou équivalent.
* Environnements Microsoft Windows Server, Active Directory et Microsoft 365\.
* Infrastructures Cloud et architectures hybrides.
* Réseaux LAN, WAN, WLAN et SD\-WAN.
* Cybersécurité, firewalls et sécurisation des infrastructures.
* Sauvegarde, continuité d'activité et Disaster Recovery.
* Environnements de Services Managés et exploitation IT.


Vous n'avez pas besoin d'être expert dans chacune de ces technologies, mais vous devez être capable d'en comprendre les enjeux, les dépendances et les contraintes de déploiement.

### Compétences complémentaires appréciées

Les expériences et certifications suivantes constituent des atouts :

* Certification PMP, PRINCE2, IPMA ou équivalente.
* Expérience dans la conduite de projets de migration Datacenter ou Cloud.
* Connaissance des technologies Huawei Enterprise.
* Expérience dans des projets de modernisation d'infrastructures VMware.
* Connaissance des processus ITIL et des environnements de Services Managés.
* Expérience dans la gestion de projets multisites.
* Participation à des projets de transformation d'infrastructures critiques.


### Vos qualités personnelles

Nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité structurée, fiable et capable de fédérer des équipes autour d'objectifs communs.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les qualités suivantes :

* **Leadership :** vous savez mobiliser et coordonner des équipes techniques sans nécessairement disposer d'une autorité hiérarchique.
* **Organisation et rigueur :** vous êtes méthodique et accordez une grande importance au respect des engagements.
* **Autonomie et responsabilité :** vous prenez en charge vos projets et assumez les décisions nécessaires à leur réussite.
* **Communication :** vous savez adapter votre discours à des interlocuteurs techniques, financiers ou décisionnels.
* **Orientation client :** vous êtes attentif à la qualité du service et à la satisfaction des clients.
* **Sens économique :** vous comprenez qu'un projet réussi doit également être un projet rentable.
* **Anticipation et proactivité :** vous identifiez les risques avant qu'ils ne deviennent des problèmes.
* **Résistance au stress :** vous savez garder votre calme et prendre du recul dans les situations complexes.
* **Esprit d'équipe :** vous privilégiez la collaboration et le partage d'informations.


Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et disposez d'un bon niveau d'anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

La connaissance de l'allemand constitue un atout.

### Ce que nous vous offrons

* Une fonction à responsabilités, avec une réelle autonomie dans le pilotage des projets.
* Des projets techniques variés auprès de clients suisses de différentes tailles.
* Une collaboration directe avec notre direction opérationnelle et notre CTO.
* Une entreprise à taille humaine favorisant les échanges directs et les décisions rapides.
* Un environnement professionnel fondé sur la confiance, la responsabilisation et l'engagement.
* La possibilité de contribuer activement à l'amélioration de nos méthodes et processus.
* Des perspectives de développement professionnel et de formation continue.


### Conditions de candidature

Vous êtes autorisé à travailler en Suisse et disposez d'un permis de conduire valable.

Vous êtes disponible pour des déplacements auprès de nos clients, principalement en Suisse romande.

Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier de candidature comprenant votre CV, vos diplômes et vos certificats de travail.

 

### **Rejoignez INGINIA et prenez part à la réalisation de projets d'infrastructure IT ambitieux, au sein d'une équipe passionnée par la technologie et la qualité de service.**

jobs.title: Director of Sales, EMEA
jobs.description:
InfluxData is the creator of InfluxDB, the leading time series platform used to collect, store, and analyze all time series data at any scale. Developers can query and analyze their time-stamped data in real-time to discover, interpret, and share new insights to gain a competitive edge. InfluxData is a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce. For more information, visit www.influxdata.com.

InfluxData is looking for an experienced Sales Leader with a strong passion for technology and can deliver on bold revenue targets. You will help lead, coach, train, scale, and motivate a team of high performing, quota crushing Account Executives and Account Manager. We are looking for a natural leader who loves to sell, can scale an effective process, is energized by developing and nurturing people, and is exceptional at inspiring prospects and customers through a complex sales process.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of Account Executives and Account Managers based in the UK and Germany

  • Prospect into Mid and large-sized companies while running an efficient sales process

  • Negotiate favorable pricing and business terms with large commercial enterprises by selling value and ROI

  • Handle existing customer expectations while expanding reach and depth into assigned territory

  • Demonstrate resourcefulness when faced with challenges that defy easy solution

  • Have intuitive sense of required steps to close business and gain customer validation

  • Identify robust set of business drivers behind all opportunities

  • Ensure high forecasting accuracy and consistency

  • Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory including existing relationships and aspirational contacts

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ Years Enterprise Field Role and minimum 3+ years in a directorial Role

  • Recent experience working for an emerging tech company (or has sold from small to big companies)

  • Demonstrated ability to win new logos and manage a book of business

  • Has met/exceeded own direct sales goals

  • Experience with Expansions especially with strategic customers who invest over $500k..

  • Demonstrated methodology to prospect and build pipeline on their own

  • President’s club, top rep, top percentile performer, consistent YoY overachievement

Bonus points if you

  • Have worked with Cloud Databases

  • Worked in the IOT or Industrial IOT space

  • Speak multiple european languages

Interview Information:

Our interview process begins remotely. Interviews are typically conducted via Zoom. To ensure every candidate can participate, please let us know if you are unable to access Zoom. Some roles may require an in-person meeting with a team member as part of the final stage.

Our Core Values

Our employees are the heart of the company and only by having a core set of beliefs and values will we be successful. We hire and live by these core values:

  • We value each other

  • We get stuff done

  • We believe humility drives learning

  • We embrace failure

  • We are committed to open source

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive - France
jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role

Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Enterprise Account Executive to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer, not just closing the deal in front of them. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory and expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role carries real weight. You'll be responsible for Public Services, where the deals are complex, the buying committees are large, and the technical bar is high. There's meaningful room here to shape how your territory gets built, not just execute against someone else's plan.

As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle for Public Services accounts in France, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Build and drive strategic account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and executive buyers.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to senior leaders and technical buyers, tailoring the pitch to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Forecast accurately and manage pipeline health with discipline, not optimism.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Proven experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end in the French Public Services market, ideally six figures or more, across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Comfort navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked deals with C-suite, IT, legal, and procurement in the room at the same time, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Strong territory and account planning instincts. You can build a plan independently, not just work from a list handed to you, and you know how to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • The ability to sell technical products credibly. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under genuine pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor, and you know what it took to earn that.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AG1 #LI-Remote

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $281,300 to $453,500

  • United Kingdom: £176,600 to £290,500

  • Singapore: S$349,400 to S$524,000

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

jobs.title: Research Lead, Evaluations
jobs.description:
About Black Forest Labs

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next.

Why This Role

BFL’s research organization is split into different focus areas, such as pre-training, post-training, reinforcement learning, data, representation learning, evaluations and more. During the day to day work, researchers from these different focus areas work together to solve exciting and hard problems towards solving visual intelligence.

Having the right means to measure what matters is the central starting point for every research project. Researchers make decisions based on the outcomes of evaluations. The right decision can only be made if an evaluation is precise and accurate. As the Evaluations Lead you’re the core driver to ensure that. Central responsibilities include building our eval roadmap in collaboration with the research and product teams, managing and extending our evaluation team, and cross-functional work with project leads to make sure each research project has the best evaluation toolbox to help the people working on it to make the right decisions. Finally, you’re responsible for growing the people in your team and maintain an eye on their long term development during the daily project work.

What You’ll Work On

  • Defining what we evaluate: You are the core driver to create, maintain and extend our evaluations roadmap by collaborating with the product and other research leads who provide the required input.

  • Defining how we evaluate: You’ll work with the team to implement our evals roadmap. This includes building new evals. Both benchmarks and the necessary objective functions, involving both automated, AI-based, and human evaluations.

  • Minimizing noise in our eval pipeline: Developing frontier AI system requires the most accurate means to measure what matters! You will ensure that results are reproducible and trustworthy, that we understand the error bars behind them and that we measure what we want to measure.

  • Understanding what we cannot measure: You’re responsible for highlighting and clearly communicate limitations of each individual evaluation and you will support our project teams to ensure that their chosen set of evaluations has no blind spots in when combined. ****

  • Observing training runs and visualizing important findings: You will help with monitoring our most critical training runs from an independent standpoint to ensure that regressions and emerging capabilities are caught early and are clearly communicated.

  • Managing our evals team: Your role is a hands-on management role - you’re responsible for growing the team and the people in it. You will define our hiring roadmap and make sure that each team member can grow within BFL, both in terms of their technical skillset and their career.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven eval experience: You’ve previously designed, run and maintained large and complex evaluation suites for frontier AI systems, involving various kinds of evaluation methods involving both human and automated (both with or without AI) approaches.

  • Strong research background: You should have proven experience of designing and implementing evaluations for AI research. Strong understanding of Python is required. A strong understanding of agentic coding is a must.

  • Experience as a people manager: One of your core responsibilities will be to grow the team and its members. Understanding what it means to lead a team and how it’s different from an IC role is a must. You should have actively managed a team for at least one year.

  • Strong understanding in statistics and good judgement about numbers: You should be familiar with variance, confidence intervals and significance testing. You should be able to identify and resolve situations when blindly trusting numbers leads to wrong conclusions.

  • Excellent communication skills: You will have to communicate results with project leads and research leadership. Understanding how to communicate these results and what they don’t tell us is important since they’re the foundation for important decisions.

  • First principles thinking: Crafting evaluations for new capabilities is not straightforward. You need to be able to derive new evals which requires proficiency in thinking from first principles

  • Prior experience in visual multimodal AI systems is a plus: Ideally you should bring experience in evaluating visual AI systems. Being familiar with additional modalities (audio, language/code, action prediction) for both generation and understanding/detection will be helpful.

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. This role is based in Freiburg, and you’ll join us in the office at least 2 days a week, or one full week every other week.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Compensation

EUR255K- 295K + equity, depending on profile

Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team.

jobs.title: AI Scientist - Domain Expert Crashworthiness
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in crashworthiness simulations to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering.

You will work at the intersection of industrial simulation, physics modeling, machine learning, and engineering workflows. Your role is to bring deep solid-mechanics expertise into the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of AI Physics Models for real engineering use cases.

This is a hands-on technical role. We are looking for someone who understands industrial structural simulation not only conceptually, but through direct experience with simulation models, solver workflows, data generation, validation, and engineering decision-making.

You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics.

Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems.

What you will do

  • Work with our research team to define, generate, and iteratively improve simulation datasets for training and evaluating crashworthiness foundation models, balancing coverage of relevant physical scenarios, simulation fidelity, and computational cost.

  • Design and run high-fidelity simulation campaigns using structural mechanics solvers such as Abaqus, LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, Radioss or equivalent tools.

  • Define the relevant variation space for training data: geometry, mesh resolution, material behavior, boundary conditions, loading, contact, joints, failure modes, and engineering KPIs.

  • Build or guide automated pipelines for simulation setup, execution, post-processing, dataset creation, and model evaluation.

  • Work with research teams to train and evaluate AI models on simulation data, and diagnose failure modes caused by data gaps, poor coverage, numerical artifacts, or model limitations.

  • Evaluate model outputs against industrial engineering needs, including field-level accuracy, scalar KPIs, deformation modes, load paths, energy absorption, stress/strain fields, failure indicators, uncertainty, and out-of-domain behavior.

  • Work with industrial customers to understand their simulation workflows and engineering priorities, define use cases and success criteria, and incorporate their feedback into model development and validation.

jobs.title: Retain Young Temporary Workers
jobs.description: And How Can You Retain Young Temporary Workers? 19-10-2026 Written by: Sude Tomak Young employees have become an essential part of the logistics, production and horticulture sectors. Yet many employers find it challenging to retain Gen Z workers. Young people tend to change jobs more frequently and have different expectations of their employers. But does this mean they are less loyal? Not necessarily. Above all, they want clear expectations, to feel valued and to have opportunities to develop their skills. Job Security, Salary and Personal Attention A good salary remains important. According to Deloitte's 2026 global survey, the cost of living is a major concern for Gen Z. Young people are therefore looking for more than just an enjoyable job. They also want financial security and stability. However, it is about more than money. Gen Z values employers who listen to them, make clear agreements and pay attention to their personal circumstances. Personal Support Makes the Difference At OPUS, we see how important personal contact is. That is why we stay in regular contact with our employees, not only when they start a new job, but also throughout their employment. How is the job going? Are there any problems? And what can we do to help someone move forward? These conversations help us understand what is happening and allow us to provide support more quickly. Practical matters also deserve attention. For example, we help employees find suitable transport options and support them with questions about their work and personal circumstances. Sometimes it is the small things that make a big difference in how someone experiences their job. Opportunities to Grow Gen Z wants to move forward. Young people value opportunities to learn new skills and build a future. At OPUS, we therefore also focus on professional development. This could include obtaining a forklift or reach truck certificate or taking a Dutch language course. By doing...

Samen met de onderhoudsploeg zorg je ervoor dat onze accommodatie netjes en klaar voor gebruik blijft. Voor voetbal, tennis én padel. Help je graag met schoonmaken? Of pak je liever een klus op? Binnen de ploeg kunnen we beide goed gebruiken. Je hoeft dus zeker geen ervaren klusser te zijn om mee te helpen. Wat kun je gaan doen? - Kleedkamers en andere ruimtes schoonmaken en opruimen. - Helpen bij het onderhoud van de voetbalvelden, tennis- en padelbanen en het terrein. - Kleine reparaties uitvoeren aan gebouwen of sportmaterialen. - Gebreken signaleren en doorgeven. - Meehelpen bij grotere schoonmaak- of onderhoudsklussen. Je hoeft niet alles te kunnen of te doen. Samen spreken we af welke werkzaamheden bij jou passen. Hoeveel tijd kost het? Voor een vaste rol binnen de onderhoudsploeg gaat het om gemiddeld vier tot zes uur per week. Heb je minder tijd? Ook dan ben je welkom. Je kunt bijvoorbeeld af en toe helpen met schoonmaken, een losse reparatie oppakken of aansluiten bij een gezamenlijke onderhoudsdag. Dit past bij jou als je… - graag praktisch bezig bent; - netjes en veilig werkt; - zelfstandig iets kunt oppakken; - het ook leuk vindt om samen te werken; - hulp vraagt als je ergens niet uitkomt. Voor schoonmaakwerk heb je geen ervaring nodig. Wil je vooral reparaties en klussen oppakken? Dan zijn enige handigheid en basiskennis van gereedschap handig. Wat levert het jou op? Je bent lekker praktisch bezig, leert andere vrijwilligers kennen én ziet direct resultaat van je werk. Een schone kleedkamer, een opgeruimd terrein of een gerepareerd net: daar hebben onze sporters en bezoekers iedere week plezier van. Eerst een keer proberen? Natuurlijk. Sluit eerst eens aan bij een klus of schoonmaakmoment en kijk daarna of je vaker wilt meehelpen. Int...

jobs.title: Customer Service Agent – EN/DE/NL
jobs.description:
Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

  • Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

  • Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

  • Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

  • Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

  • Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

  • Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

  • Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

The position is Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work during particularly busy periods.

You will work in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

Flexibility regarding working hours is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge & experience

  • Very good English – essential for the position.

  • Good knowledge of German.

  • Good knowledge of Dutch.

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

  • Previous experience in administration, customer service or case management is a strong asset.

  • Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

  • No specific experience is required, as full training will be provided.

Skills & personality

  • Excellent telephone communication skills.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

  • Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

  • Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

  • Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

  • Flexible and quick to adapt to new tools, procedures and situations.

  • Reliable, motivated and eager to learn.

jobs.title: Customer Service Admin
jobs.description:
Our client is a dynamic and growing company in the region of Oostende.

Jobomschrijving

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!

A selection of your responsibilities:

  • You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
  • You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
  • You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
  • You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
  • You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.
  • You register and handle returns, claims and complaints in a timely manner and propose ways to prevent recurring issues.
  • You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.
  • You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools.

We are looking for the following profile:

  • You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
  • You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
  • You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
  • You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
  • You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
  • You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
  • You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
  • You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
  • You are available for a full-time position.

jobs.title: Shiftleader Fastfood
jobs.description:
Heb jij leiderschap en een passie voor voeding in je DNA zitten? Dan bij jij de shiftleader die wij zoeken!!

Als Shiftleader zal jij instaan voor het goede verloop van de dag op elk mogelijk vlak.

jobs.description: Description du poste :Rattaché(é) directement au Directeur Exécutif, vous êtes la tour de contrôle opérationnelle de votre région, vous pilotez la performance de trois sites (environ 30 collaborateurs) en garantissant l'excellence de service, la rentabilité financière et la satisfaction client. Vous structurez le quotidien de vos équipes techniques et ADV tout en optimisant le potentiel du parc clients existant.Vos principales missions Pilotage opérationnel & plannings : structurer et optimiser au quotidien les tournées, la planification des interventions et le suivi des heures de l'équipe technique pour maximiser la réactivité et la qualité de service Développement du parc clients existant : fidéliser le portefeuille actuel, accroître le taux de pénétration des services et promouvoir la vente de solutions complémentaires (notamment le développement de la gamme café et matériel CHR) auprès des partenaires installés Gestion économique & P&L : suivre les comptes d'exploitation de chaque filiale, piloter les stocks, analyser la rentabilité des chantiers et fiabiliser les indicateurs clés (KPI Management & structuration RH : animer et accompagner les relais de sites, encadrer les équipes techniques et ADV, gérer les recrutements, la montée en compétences et le suivi administratif/disciplinaire en lien avec le siège Standardisation & amélioration continue : concevoir, tester et fiabiliser de nouveaux process d'exploitation déployable à l'échelle du groupe.Description du profil :Manager de terrain pragmatique et structuré, vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie dans le pilotage opérationnel d'un centre de profit ou d'une agence technique de prestations de services (idéalement multisite).À l'aise avec la gestion par les chiffres et l'analyse de données d'activité, vous êtes reconnu pour votre sens rigoureux de l'organisation et votre capacité à résoudre rapidement les aléas du quotidien.Autonome, débrouillard et doté d'une réelle sensibilité technique, vous savez fédérer des profils variés et faire grandir une organisation en pleine structuration.

jobs.title: Laboratoriohoitaja Diagnostiikkakeskus Preanalytiikka Espoo ja Länsi-Uusimaa
jobs.description: Laboratoriohoitaja, tunnetko, että asiakaspalvelu- ja näytteenottotehtävät ovat sinun juttusi? Haluatko työskennellä päivätyöluonteisessa tehtävässä asiakasrajapinnassa? Meillä on mahdollisuus kehittyä urallasi erilaisten vastuutehtävien parissa.HUS Diagnostiikkakeskus on Suomen johtava kliinisten laboratorio- ja kuvantamispalvelujen tuottaja. Pääasiallinen toiminta-alueemme on HUS-yhtymän erikoissairaanhoito ja HUSiin kuuluvien hyvinvointialueiden perusterveydenhuolto. Vastaamme myös Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen ja Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialueen laboratorio- ja kuvantamistoiminnasta.Toimimme kahdeksalla lääketieteen erikoisalalla. Vastaamme valtakunnallisesti useista erityisosaamista vaativista tutkimuksista sekä yliopistolliselle sairaalalle kuuluvasta tutkimuksesta ja opetuksesta. Diagnostiset tutkimukset ovat keskeisessä roolissa sairauksien varmistamisessa, poissulkemisessa, osana hoitoa sekä hoidon seurannassa ja seulonnassa. HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksessa työskentelee noin 3400 laboratorio- ja kuvantamisalan asiantuntijaa yli 150 toimipisteessä.Haemmelaboratoriohoitajaavakituiseen tehtävään Diagnostiikkakeskukseen Espoon ja Länsi-Uusimaan terveysasemalaboratorioihin ensisijaisesti Lohjan terveyskeskuslaboratorioon.Laboratoriohoitajana terveysasemalaboratoriossa toimit tärkeässä roolissa preanalytiikan parissa. Laboratoriohoitajana pääset vaikuttamaan laadukkaaseen ja potilasturvalliseen näytteenottoon, joka on keskeinen tavoitteemme. Työpäiväsi sisältää asiakasneuvontaa, verinäytteenottoa, gynekologista näytteenottoa ja sydänfilmien ottamista. Panostamme yksiköissämme yksilölliseen perehdytykseen sekä osaamisen ylläpitämiseen ja kehittymiseen. Mielenkiintosi mukaan sinulla on myös mahdollisuus erilaisten vastuutehtävien hoitamiseen.Arvostamme sinussa oma-aloitteisuutta, aktiivisuutta, joustavuutta ja hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Työ edellyttää myönteistä ja innokasta asennetta asiakaspalveluun sekä itsenäiseen- ja tiimityöskentelyyn. Paineensietokykysi tulee olla hyvä, ja toimit ammatillisesti kaikissa tilanteissa. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.Meillä HUSissa olet osa huippuammattilaisten joukkoa. jobs.title: Télépilote de drone (H/F)
jobs.description: Innov'ATM et votre rôleLa société Innov'ATM a été créée en 2014 avec l'ambition de proposer des produits et des services innovants pour la gestion de trafic aérien (ATM) et de gestion du trafic aérien des drones (UTM). Aujourd'hui, Innov'ATM permet à tous les acteurs de l'écosystème de gérer en toute sécurité et en toute simplicité l'ensemble des opérations dans un espace aérien (ATM et UTM).Depuis 2024, Innov'ATM a créé DroneMed: un service de livraison médicale par drone, il permet aux établissements de santé et aux laboratoires d'acheminer des prélèvements biologiques et des médicaments par des autoroutes aériennes.Précurseur de la livraison médicale par drone en France, et premier U-space Services Provider Français, DroneMed propose une alternative au transport routier traditionnel et opère déjà plusieurs lignes dans différentes régions, en métropole comme en outre-mer, et poursuit activement son déploiement.Rejoindre DroneMed, c'est contribuer au développement d'un service innovant, utile et en forte croissance, au croisement des secteurs de la santé, du drone et de la mobilité aérienne.Le posteInnov'ATM recrute un-e télépilote pour assurer la supervision des opérations DroneMed sur les lignes en France métropolitaine comme en outre-mer.* Sur le terrain : une supervision au plus près des opérations. Pendant les phases de test, de validation et de transition vers l'exploitation, vous êtes présent-e sur les sites afin de préparer, superviser et sécuriser les vols. Cette présence terrain constitue aujourd'hui le cœur du poste.* Depuis nos bureaux : une supervision à distance, depuis le centre de contrôle DroneMed, pour les lignes déjà en phase d'exploitation.Vos missions* Vous assurerez la supervision des vols DroneMed, en tant que télépilote/superviseur de vols.À ce titre, vous serez responsable de l'opération, de sa préparation jusqu'à sa clôture, et vos missions seront les suivantes :Préparer l'opération :* Rédiger la fiche mission et analyser le contexte : météo, informations aéronautiques, zones survolées, espaces aériens voisins, mesures de contingence et Plan de Réponse d'Urgence (PRU).* Déployer le matériel (drone, vertiport, batteries, etc) sur site, réaliser les vérifications avant vol selon les checklists et animer le briefing de l'équipage.Superviser les vols :* Surveiller en continu le drone, sa trajectoire et son environnement, et coordonner l'équipage (second télépilote, personnel au sol) avec une phraséologie normalisée.* Appliquer les procédures de contingence et d'urgence, déclencher le PRU si nécessaire, et retarder, interrompre ou annuler un vol dès que la sécurité l'exige.* Assurer l'après-vol : inspection du drone, carnet de vol, fiche mission et rangement du matériel.Gestion de la sécurité et amélioration continue* Animer le débriefing après chaque opération, consigner tout événement et remonter les anomalies observées sur le terrain.* Appliquer les consignes de sécurité, participer aux exercices PRU et aux formations, et proposer des améliorations des procédures.Missions complémentaires possiblesSelon les besoins, vous pourrez aussi participer à la maintenance du drone, à l'installation des équipements sur les sites, à la formation du personnel des sites partenaires et à la mise en service de nouvelles lignes.Profil recherchéNous recherchons une personne rigoureuse, fiable et ingénieuse, qui aime le travail sur le terrain, au plus près des usagers.Formations et CertificatsVous avez déjà vos certificats de télépilote ? C'est un vrai atout :* l'attestation pour la catégorie ouverte (A1/A3) et la formation complémentaire A2 ;* le certificat théorique de télépilote (CATS) et une formation pratique aux scénarios STS.Vous ne les avez pas encore ? Postulez quand même. Nous cherchons d'abord une personne motivée, débrouillarde et à l'aise sur le terrain. Les certifications nécessaires pourront être passées après l'embauche et prises en charge par Innov'ATM.Dans tous les cas, nous assurons à la prise de poste les formations sur le drone, sur les lignes DroneMed et sur nos procédures internes.Seul impératif : le permis B, car les missions impliquent des déplacements en véhicule avec le matériel.Compétences et qualités attendues* Anglais : certains manuels sont rédigés en anglais.* Ingéniosité : vous trouvez des solutions concrètes face aux imprévus du terrain (matériel, logistique, site).* Rigueur : vous suivez les procédures et les checklists à la lettre.* Sang-froid : vous gardez votre calme et savez prendre une décision quand la situation se complique.* Esprit d'équipe : vous communiquez de façon claire et concise avec l'équipage.* Sens de la sécurité : vous signalez ce qui ne va pas et tirez les leçons de chaque opération.* Adaptabilité : vous êtes à l'aise sur des sites variés, en déplacement, et savez vous organiser seul-e.* Aisance avec les outils numériques : logiciels de pilotage, de planification et de s...

jobs.title: Lead Software Developer, SCADA
jobs.description: Lead Software Developer. Siinä on energiaa - Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää! Lämmön, jäähdytyksen ja sähkön lisäksi tarjoamme ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan sekä sähköiseen liikenteeseen. Kehitämme fiksumpaa ja puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää, jonka avulla pidämme huolta, että asiakkaamme voivat tuottaa, käyttää ja säästää energiaa ympäristöä kunnioittaen. Haluaisitko olla mukana kehittämässä Helenin energiantuotannon ohjauksen kannalta keskeisiä järjestelmiä ja rakentamassa SCADA-ohjelmistokehityskyvykkyyttämme? Tule meille Lead Software Developeriksi SCADA ja valvomo -ratkaisutiimiin. Työsuhde on vakituinen. Roolissa työskentelet osana SCADA ja valvomo -ratkaisutiimiä, joka vastaa energiantuotannon ohjaus- ja valvomojärjestelmien kehittämisestä sekä keskeytymättömästä tiedonkulusta tuotantolaitosten ja valvomon välillä. Tiimin ratkaisut mahdollistavat laitosten reaaliaikaisen automaattisen säädön ja muodostavat huoltovarmuuden kannalta kriittisen kokonaisuuden, jonka ympärivuorokautisesta toimintavarmuudesta huolehditaan yhdessä kumppaneiden kanssa. Lead Software Developerina otat vahvan teknisen roolin tämän järjestelmäkokonaisuuden kehittämisessä. Pääset tekemään käytännön ohjelmistokehitystä sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miten Helenin omaa kehityskyvykkyyttä, teknisiä ratkaisuja ja toimintatapoja rakennetaan nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Roolissasi Otat teknistä vetovastuuta Helenin SCADA-järjestelmien ohjelmistokehityksestä ja niiden pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä.Suunnittelet, kehität ja ylläpidät SCADA-järjestelmän ohjelmistokomponentteja, integraatioita ja käyttöliittymiä.Varmistat yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa ratkaisujen ylläpidettävyyden, toimintavarmuuden ja skaalautuvuuden. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä energiantuotannon, optimoinnin, automaation ja muiden ohjelmistokehittäjien kanssa ja viet tarpeita toimiviksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi. Osallistut järjestelmien teknisen arkkitehtuurin ja tulevaisuuden ratkaisujen suunnitteluun sekä yhteistyöhön järjestelmätoimittajien kanssa. Odotamme sinulta Vahvaa kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä sekä kykyä ottaa teknistä vastuuta laajoista ja liiketoimintakriittisistä järjestelmistä. Kokemusta SCADA- tai muista OT-ympäristöistä, kuten valvomokäyttöliittymistä ja teollisista integraatioista. Ymmärrystä teollisuuden tietoliikenneprotokollista, kuten OPC UA, IEC-104, ICCP ja Modbus. Kokemusta moderneista ohjelmistokehityksen käytännöistä, kuten automatisoidusta testauksesta, CI/CDä ja versionhallinnasta, sekä AI-avusteisten työkalujen hyödyntämisestä ohjelmistokehityksessä. Kykyä hahmottaa laajoja teknisiä kokonaisuuksia, tehdä perusteltuja ratkaisuja ja viedä niitä käytäntöön yhdessä muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Eduksi katsomme Kokemuksen WinCC OA -järjestelmästä ja sen ohjelmistokehityksestä. Kokemuksen automaatiojärjestelmien konfiguroinnista ja toimintaperiaatteista. Kokemuksen energiantuotannon tai muiden kriittisten teollisten järjestelmien parissa työskentelystä. Kokemuksen Databricks-ympäristöstä sekä data-alustan ja operatiivisten järjestelmien välisistä dataratkaisuista. Tarjoamme sinulle Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan konkreettisesti energiantuotannon ohjausjärjestelmien tulevaisuuteen. Roolissa yhdistyvät käytännön ohjelmistokehitys, tekninen vetovastuu ja mahdollisuus kehittää toimintatapoja sekä järjestelmien laatua ja toimintavarmuutta. Työskentelet monipuolisessa ympäristössä, jossa SCADA ja automaatio, moderni ohjelmistokehitys, data-alusta ja energiajärjestelmän optimointi kytkeytyvät yhä tiiviimmin yhteen. jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this."

You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute.

If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts

  • Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory

  • Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit

  • Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages.

  • Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time

  • Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice

  • Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution

  • Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces


What You’ll Bring:

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows

  • Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production

  • Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for

  • A track record of finishing what others started: turning a partial or unstable implementation into something genuinely reliable in production

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code practice (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) as the authoritative source of environment configuration

  • Comfortable operating in a regulated, security-conscious environment where architecture decisions have compliance implications

  • Familiarity with AWS cost structure, along with the ability to factor in cost-related considerations when designing infrastructure

  • Professional English; Dutch is a plus

Nice to have:

  • Experience specifically with observability/logging platforms at scale (e.g. OpenSearch, Grafana/Loki stacks, or equivalent) — bringing an implementation to production-hardened state, not just standing it up

  • Experience in medical device, healthcare, or another regulated industry

  • Familiarity with multi-tenant, per-customer cloud architectures (e.g. isolated accounts or workloads per client/region)

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including a pension plan

  • 25 days of annual leave (full-time position)

  • A high-skilled team based in Utrecht

  • Frequent out-of-work team activities and an annual company weekend away

  • A training budget

  • The chance to help shape the new niche of autonomous medical robotics

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! 

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together!

The role combines customer order management, supply chain coordination, process control and performance monitoring across the complete order lifecycle.- Manage repair, lease and exchange orders, including order conversion and end-to-end order processing from the repair station through to the customer.- Act as the central contact for airlines, maintenance, repair and overhaul organisations, suppliers and repair stations regarding order status, commercial matters and aircraft-on-ground enquiries.- Monitor supplier and repair station performance against contractual obligations, agreed key performance indicators, delivery times, costs and quality targets.- Coordinate daily communication with repair stations to ensure reliable progress for open orders and timely transfer of piece parts required for individual repairs.- Analyse customer-specific problems, complaints and delivery risks, then coordinate suitable solutions with internal departments and external partners throughout the supply chain.- Provide customers with accurate and timely updates on component repairs, alternative service solutions, expected completion dates and relevant process changes.- Support purchasing, sales processing, material process management, demand planning and cost control for proprietary parts.- Prepare performance reports covering new, closed and open claims, shop processing time, turnaround time and action trackers, while contributing to projects focused on process improvement and future ways of working.VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:- A completed bachelor's degree or comparable qualification in industrial engineering, business administration, business economics, economics or a related field.- Practical experience in disposition, material procurement, customer service, customer care, supplier management or order fulfilment; experience in several of these areas is advantageous.- Knowledge of project management and process improvement, with the ability to coordinate actions across customers, suppliers, repair stations and internal departments.- Strong process control skills, including structured order tracking, demand planning, delivery monitoring, cost control and data analysis.- Confident use of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office, including detailed functions for analysing order, performance and supply chain data.- Practical experience with SAP and collaborative digital work environments is beneficial for managing information and maintaining transparent process documentation.- Negotiation-level English for customer communication, stakeholder coordination and professional documentation; French, German or Spanish would be an advantage.- High customer orientation, responsiveness, intercultural understanding, resilience, personal responsibility and strong organisational skills.Benefits:- An unlimited employment contract- 35-hour workweek- 30 days of annual leave- An annual salary of around 72.000 €- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

jobs.title: Postdoc (f_m_x) – Hydraulic Stimulation for Enhanced Geothermal Systems (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: "Taking the pulse of our Earth to safeguard a habitable planet."For the EU-funded project UPLIFT in section4.3 Geoenergy (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/geoenergy/overview) (department 'Geosystems (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geosystems) '), we are looking for a:Research scientist (f_m_x) – Geothermal Reservoir StimulationReference Number 11660UPLIFT (https://uplift-horizon.eu/) brings together key European Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS (https://www.geothermie.de/bibliothek/lexikon-der-geothermie/e/egs) ) industry and research institutions to demonstrate, at Czechia's leading energy research site RINGEN, how water-only multi-stage hydraulic shear stimulation treatments can be efficiently implemented in metamorphic basement rocks in Europe, while reducing technical, social, and environmental risks.A central focus is the development and application of adaptive stimulation designs that use real-time seismic and hydraulic data to improve treatment efficiency and safety. The project will also investigate micro-turbine drilling as an alternative to conventional perforation techniques to improve reservoir access. Laboratory experiments will assess the self-propping behaviour of European basement rocks and benchmark their stimulation response against acid- and proppant-based methods. Water-only and proppant-based stimulation treatments will also be compared at the Bedretto Underground Laboratory. In parallel, the project will develop high-fidelity, physics-based digital twins to guide stimulation design, alongside fast surrogate models to support real-time operational decision-making. The stimulation activities are supported by high-resolution, real-time seismic monitoring, conventional and adaptive traffic light systems, and social science research.As a postdoctoral researcher, you will play a central role in planning, supervising and analysing the adaptive multi-stage hydraulic stimulation treatments at the RINGEN EGS site in Litoměřice, Czechia. This position offers the opportunity to connect advanced research with field operations and contribute directly to developing efficient, safe geothermal stimulation technologies.Your responsibilities:- Co-lead the hydraulic stimulation and well test activities at the Litoměřice EGS site- Analyse stimulation and well test data to compare and understand the hydraulic and seismic response of metamorphic basement rock to different stimulation methods and injection protocols, including adaptive injection strategies- Contribute to detailed operational planning and the preparation of tender documents- Contribute to the techno-economic assessment of different stimulation methods and their implications for EGS development- Publish your findings in peer-reviewed journals and communicate them at scientific conferences and to non-scientific stakeholdersAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- A Master's degree (or equivalent) and a PhD (or equivalent industry experience) in reservoir/petroleum engineering, drilling/completion engineering, geophysics, geothermal energy, applied geosciences, or equivalent- Research or industry background in Enhanced Geothermal Systems, well stimulation or induced seismicity- Well test analysis- Proficiency in spoken and written EnglishDesirable Qualifications:- German or Czech language skills are useful, but not required- Strong motivation and creativity, combined with an independent, structured, reliable and results-oriented working attitude- Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with interdisciplinary project partners, the scientific community, engineers, and non-technical stakeholdersStart date: 1st February 2027Fixed-term: 36 MonateSalary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den tariflichen Bestimmungen und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen.Working hours: Vollzeit (derzeit 39 h/Woche); die Stelle ist grundsätzlich teilzeitgeeignet.Place of work: PotsdamWhat we offer:- Ambitious and varied tasks in a dynamic and international research environment- State-of-the-art equipment- Public service benefits- Extensive training opportunities- Professional career advice offered by our in-house Career-Centre- Flexible working hours and conditions- Support with finding a good work-life balance offered by benefit@work- Institute day-care centre on site- Working at the Albert Einstein Science Park on the Telegrafenberg in Potsdam- Workplace within walking distance of Potsdam main train station, or just a short ride on the shuttle busHave we piqued your interest?If so, we look forward to receiving your application by 13th December 2026. Please use our online application form only.Required documents: letter of motivation, CV, grades/certificatesThe GFZ actively promotes diversity and equal opportunities. We explicitly welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of ethnic and social origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation and identity, religion/belief, age, and physical or neurodiverse abilities.“Diversity in perspectives” is one of GFZ's core values. As an integral part of supporting diversity at our centre, we actively promote women in science and in leadership positions. To know more about our Diversity policies, contact the diversity team. If you need more information about our gender equality policies, please do not hesitate to contact our Equal Opportunities Officer (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/the-gfz-as-an-employer/employee-representation) and check our Equal Opportunities Plan & Cascade Model (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/the-gfz-as-an-employer/equal-opportunities) .We look forward to applications from people who enjoy working in diverse teams, where everyone feels respected and valued and can fully develop their own talents. Applicants with severe disabilities and equalised persons will receive preferential consideration if equally qualified.Data protection information for applicants (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/job-offers#c95430)In case of any further queries regarding the field of activity, please contact Prof. Dr. Hannes Hofmann (hannes.hofmann@gfz.de) via email. If you have any general questions about the application process, please contact our recruiting team at our phone number +49 (0) 331-6264-28787.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d)  in Conservation Genetics and Genetic Monitoring (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) in Conservation Genetics and Genetic MonitoringSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Department of Genomic Biomonitoring at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as of 01.02.2027:**Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) in Conservation Genetics and Genetic Monitoring ****(Full-Time / Part-Time)**Location: FrankfurtEmployment scope: Full-Time / Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.Genetic diversity is a fundamental component of biodiversity, providing the evolutionary potential that allows species and populations to adapt to environmental change. Yet genetic diversity is declining and remains comparatively underrepresented in biodiversity monitoring and policy. At the Genomic Biomonitoring Lab at Senckenberg, we work to address that gap and are seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join us in that aim.The position will focus on how genetic diversity can be measured, monitored and incorporated into practical conservation. This spans from species-level applications to national and international biodiversity policy. The researcher will contribute to ongoing projects on endangered and threatened species where genomics is needed to support management or can be used for monitoring. At the international scale, there is scope to investigate how genetic diversity can be incorporated into global biodiversity frameworks and assessments.We are looking for a researcher who is excited to help shape this emerging research area. The postdoctoral researcher will have the opportunity to develop new research questions and projects under our shared research programme. We are particularly interested in candidates who combine deep scientific curiosity with a motivation to translate ideas into practical conservation impact. Experience working in conservation genetics or genomics is thus essential.Your tasks- Conduct high-quality research on conservation genomics, genetic monitoring and integration of genetic diversity into policy.- Develop and apply approaches for monitoring and protecting genetic diversity in wild populations in Germany and at focal international sites.- Work on connecting genetic diversity with national and international policy.- Collaborate with researchers, conservation organisations, and other stakeholders.- Publish findings in high-quality peer-reviewed journals and present results at international conferences.- Communicate research findings to non-academic audiences, including through policy briefs and communication with conservation managers, and policymakers.- Supervise BSc and/or MSc thesis students.- Help develop international funding proposals for genetic diversity protection and monitoring.Your profile- A PhD in population/conservation/evolutionary genomics or a related field.- At least one year of postdoctoral research experience.- Hands-on experience with genomic datasets.- Experience in conservation biology and biodiversity protection, including collaboration with conservation practitioners, managers, or policy makers.- A strong publication record appropriate to your career stage.Desirable skills- Excellent scientific writing and communication skills in English.- Experience or a strong interest in developing research proposals and securing third-party funding.- A collaborative, collegial and well-organised approach to research and teamwork.We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.Senckenberg is certified under the audit berufundfamilie programme and is committed to promoting a better work-life balance.How to apply?Please upload your applicationelectronically as a single PDF by 05.12.2026, containing:- A letter of motivation (1-2 pages), including clear explanations about your interest in the position and an outline of how your experience fits the research programme.- CV and publication list.- PhD certificate.- Contact details for two academic refereesPlease upload your application by clicking on the "Apply Online" button in the bottom of this announcement. Applications via email cannot be considered.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Deborah Leighat deborah.leigh@senckenberg.de

jobs.title: Rezeptionist/in auf Burg Breuberg (m/w/d) (Empfangskraft)
jobs.description: **Starte bei uns als Rezeptionist/in ab 01.02.2027 durch! (m/w/d) **Du bist Gastgeber aus Leidenschaft? Du suchst eine Aufgabe, die Dich erfüllt?Du möchtest Dich in einem Verein engagieren, der der Nachhaltigkeit und dem Gemeinwohl verpflichtet ist? Wenn Du alle Fragen mit „Ja“ beantwortet hast, möchten wir Dich kennenlernen.Deine Mission bei uns- Du packst dort an, wo gerade Unterstützung gebraucht wird, Rezeption - Programme - Küche -Reinigung -Wäsche- Empfang und Betreuung unserer Gäste- Check-In / Check-out- Bearbeitung von Buchungsanfragen- Telefon- und E-Mail-Kommunikation- Allgemeine administrative und organisatorische Aufgaben im Rezeptionsbereich- Du arbeitest flexibel im Schichtdienst, übernimmst auch mal den Spätdienst- Du bist auch an Wochenenden und Sonn- und Feiertagen einsatzbereit- Als Basis deiner Arbeit nutzt du unsere festgelegten Qualitätsstandards und trägst so zu einem einmaligen Gästeerlebnis beiWir bieten dir- Vertrauen und Respekt bei einer 20-25 Stundenwoche (individuell abgestimmt)- Platz für deine Kreativität- Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag in einer familiär-freundschaftlichen Atmosphäre- Einen sinnstiftenden Arbeitsplatz in einer Organisation mit hoher Gemeinwohlorientierung- Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld sowie Sozialversicherungsfreie Sonn- und Feiertagszuschläge- Faire Bezahlung der Grundvergütung durch unsere transparente Vergütungsrichtlinie- 28 Tage Urlaub (anteilig)- Kostenfreie Verpflegung (wenn für Gäste gekocht wird)- Eine kostenlose Mitgliedschaft im DJH für die ganze Familie inkl. Rabatte (Sportartikel, Sprachreisen, Busreisen)- 50% Übernachtungsrabatt in den Jugendherbergen in Hessen- Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote- Coole Mitarbeitenden-Bekleidung- Corporate Benefits- Team-EventsDas bringst du mit- Du kannst dich schnell in neue Abläufe und Aufgabengebiete einarbeiten- PC- Kenntnisse (Microsoft Office)- Du bist flexibel, selbst organisiert, kreativ und arbeitest eigenverantwortlich- Durch deinen ausgeprägten Servicegedanken fühlen sich unsere Gäste bei dir wohl und willkommen- Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse- Du bist mobil und verfügst über einen eigenen, fahrbaren Untersatz (PKW, Roller etc.), da die Anreise zur Burg nicht per ÖPNV oder zu Fuß möglich ist- Ein respektvolles Miteinander ist dir wichtig- Du trittst sauber, gepflegt und vorbildlich aufWer wir sindIn unseren 28 Jugendherbergen schaffen wir Orte, an denen echte Erlebnisse entstehen. Rund 500 engagierte Mitarbeitende prägen unsere Häuser mit den Schwerpunkten Umwelt, Kultur sowie Aktiv & Fit und füllen unser Motto „Gemeinschaft erleben“  jeden Tag mit Leben.So entsteht eine Atmosphäre, in der sich jährlich etwa 250.000 Gäste wohlfühlen: von der Schulklasse über Gruppen bis hin zu Familien. Nachhaltig, offen, dem Gemeinwohl verpflichte und immer mit dem Ziel, unvergessliche Momente für alle möglich zu machen.Du bist interessiert, hast aber noch Fragen? Dann melde dich gerne:Jugendherberge Burg BreubergBianca Grümbel06431 41493Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bitte hab Verständnis dafür, dass wir etwaige Fahrtkosten zu einem Gespräch leider nicht erstatten können.
