jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role

Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

  • Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

  • Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

  • Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

  • Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

  • Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

  • Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

  • Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

  • Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

  • Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

  • Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

  • Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

Your background

You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

  • A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

  • Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

  • Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

  • A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

  • A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

  • Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦

  • Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;

  • Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;

  • Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.

  • Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.

  • Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

KPIs & Success Measures

We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output:

  • Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun and exciting. 

 

About the Role

As a Jr. UI Developer, you will be an essential part of our team, assisting in the implementation of stunning, user-friendly web applications. Working alongside experienced developers, you will use HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript to help translate designs into high-quality web experiences for our events and platforms. This position is ideal for an early-career developer who is passionate about visually-focused development, eager to learn best practices in CSS and JavaScript, and excited to collaborate within a supportive team environment. You will gain hands-on experience with branding, workflows, and enterprise-grade software development.

\n


How you will contribute:

  • Assist in developing, updating, and maintaining UI components and branding with a strong focus on design and responsiveness.

  • Collaborate closely with senior developers, designers, and Product Management to learn processes and deliver quality work.

  • Write clean, maintainable HTML, CSS (using SASS and utility classes), and basic JavaScript (including exposure to React and Svelte).

  • Help troubleshoot, debug, and fix styling issues or UI-related bugs across different browsers and devices.

  • Participate in code reviews to receive feedback, learn RainFocus coding standards, and improve your skills.

  • Support the team in configuring client white-labeling, templates, and basic event workflows.


Required Experience/ Skills:

  • 1â2 years of professional web development experience, or equivalent experience through bootcamps, internships, or robust portfolio projects.

  • Solid fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS, and CSS preprocessors like SASS.

  • Basic understanding of vanilla JavaScript and an eagerness to learn modern frameworks like React and Svelte.

  • Understanding of responsive design principles and cross-browser compatibility.

  • Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive mindset, self-motivated to ask questions, learn, and grow as a developer.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Works well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Exposure to design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Photoshop.

  • Basic awareness of web accessibility (WCAG) standards.

  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.

  • General understanding of how APIs or backend systems (like Java) interact with front-end code.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

jobs.title: Account Executive, Growth (EMEA)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. As an Account Executive at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role is specifically based in London. We’re looking for someone who can work from our London office in Shoreditch 3 days per week (Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays), as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region. 

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly and annual targets

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

What we're looking for

 - 5+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling to a technical audience; bonus if you have previous experience working with a collaboration or developer tool

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms 

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

 - Make an Org Chart You Want to Ship — Advice from Linear on How Heirloom Tomatoes Should Inspire Team Design https://review.firstround.com/make-an-org-chart-you-want-to-ship-advice-from-linear-on-how-heirloom-tomatoes-should-inspire-team-design/

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer

We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

jobs.title: Junior Market Analyst
jobs.description:
MEYA HOLDINGS LTD is an international company specializing in digital assets, cryptocurrency markets, and financial research. We focus on developing data-driven trading approaches and optimizing market operations. Our remote team brings together professionals from different parts of the world.

We are looking for a motivated Junior Market Analyst with at least 1 year of experience in cryptocurrency or financial trading. You will assist with market analysis, monitor trading performance, and contribute to improving our daily operational processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor cryptocurrency prices, trading volumes, and market developments.
  • Analyze market data and identify potential trading opportunities.
  • Assist with daily Spot, Futures, and Options trading activities.
  • Monitor asset allocation across centralized and decentralized exchanges.
  • Prepare reports on market conditions and trading performance.
  • Identify operational or technical issues and coordinate with the relevant teams.
  • Monitor automated trading systems and ensure compliance with risk management rules.
  • Maintain accurate financial and operational records.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to improve trading processes.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote position with no geographical restrictions.
  • Flexible working hours across different time zones.
  • Access to professional trading platforms and analytical tools.
  • Opportunity to gain practical experience in digital asset markets.
  • Career development opportunities within an international company.
  • Friendly working environment with ongoing support and feedback.

Requirements

  • Basic understanding of spot, futures, and options markets.
  • Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work under pressure and make quick decisions.
  • Good communication skills in English (written and spoken).
  • Team player, adaptable, and self-organized.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist i Lissabon Portugal
jobs.description:
Er du passioneret omkring digital markedsføring og har erfaring med at optimere online kampagner? Vi leder efter en dygtig og analytisk Digital Marketing Specialist til at blive en del af vores internationale team i Lissabon!

Dine ansvarsområder vil inkludere:

  • Implementere optimeringsløsninger og strategier for vores højværdi-kunder.

  • Annoncering på sociale medier, primært via Google Ads.

  • Udarbejdelse af keyword-pakker, budstrategier og budgetforslag.

  • Udvikle ekspertise i Googles produkter ved hjælp af optimeringsteknikker, herunder Google Search Network (GSN), Mobile og YouTube.

  • Analysere data og tendenser for at skabe meningsfulde indsigter og rapportere på centrale KPI’er.

Vi søger dig, som har:

  • Minimum 12 måneders erfaring med annonceringsoptimering (Google Ads foretrækkes, men erfaring med Meta Ads, Instagram Ads og LinkedIn Ads er også relevant).

  • En struktureret tilgang, stærke analytiske evner og lyst til at arbejde i et internationalt miljø.

  • Gode kommunikationsevner på engelsk (skriftligt og mundtligt).

Vi tilbyder:

  • Hybrid arbejdsmodel (2 dage om ugen på kontoret).

  • Kontor i det kreative og moderne LACS Anjos i Lissabon.

  • Relocation-pakke og støtte til at få NIF og NISS (for kandidater der flytter til Portugal).

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring, inkl. tandlæge- og familieplan.

  • Livsforsikring.

  • En arbejdsplads hvor udvikling, fællesskab og innovation vægtes højt.

Lyder det som noget for dig?Send din ansøgning og CV til LB@jobsqd.com – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
jobs.description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
At Serve Robotics, weâre reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. Itâs designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. Weâre looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Accountant supports the company's accounting operations by maintaining accurate financial records, performing assigned close activities, and preparing financial reports. The role executes and monitors key accounting processes, partners with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve discrepancies, supports audits, and helps maintain compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and company policies.

JOB DUTIES

  • Oversee the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy.

  • Perform account reconciliations, including bank, accounts payable, and accounts receivable reconciliations, and resolve identified discrepancies.

  • Prepare and post journal entries and maintain an accurate and current general ledger.

  • Review, classify, and record expenses in accordance with company policies and applicable budget guidelines.

  • Oversee key accounting processes, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, inventory, accruals, and prepaid expenses.

  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and providing timely, accurate responses to requests.

  • Monitor accounting activities for compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and established company procedures.

  • Identify and recommend process improvements that strengthen controls and increase the efficiency and accuracy of accounting operations.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical accounting experience.

  • 5+ years of full accounting experience

  • Proficiency with accounting software such as Xero or NetSuite and intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, or GAAP, and a strong understanding of Sarbanes Oxley compliance processes, internal controls, and financial reporting requirements.

  • Strong organizational, time management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and partner effectively across teams.

  • High degree of accuracy and analytical ability, including the ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve accounting discrepancies and process inefficiencies.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Progress toward CPA certification.

  • Experience with a publicly traded company or public accounting firm.

  • Experience in a startup or other fast paced environment.

  • Experience with robotics, manufacturing, or technology companies, including exposure to inventory management or cost accounting processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to adapt and operate effectively in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

Iskustvo sa solarnim elektranama ili tehničkim proizvodima predstavlja prednost, ali nije uvjet. Osiguravamo edukaciju o solarnim elektranama i našem prodajnom procesu. jobs.title: CNC TOKAR / TOKARICA NA CNC KARUSELU
jobs.description:
TMT d.o.o. Čakovec traži iskusnog, odgovornog i samostalnog djelatnika za radno mjesto CNC tokar – operater / CNC tokarica / oeraterka na CNC vertikalnom tokarskom stroju (karuselu).

Opis poslova

jobs.title: Agile Program Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time.

This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives.
  • Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning.
  • Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options.
  • Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates.
  • Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value.
  • Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences.
  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed.
  • Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift.
  • Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments.
  • Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar).
  • Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting.
  • Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves.

Nice to Have

  • Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile.
  • Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization.
  • Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery.
  • Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management.
  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements.
  • Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners.

jobs.title: Feltsense AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the company

We raised $5.1M to build agents that operate as fully autonomous founders. Our backers include Matt Schlicht (founder of Moltbook), the founders of Crunchbase and Republic, and VCs including Draper, Precursor, and Liquid2.

We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.

Our system identifies business opportunities through market signals, validates ideas with live ad tests, builds and launches software products, and brings in human experts wherever agents fall short. That loop already runs end to end: from idea to launched product to first revenue.

Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.

You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.

You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.

  • Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.

  • Develop self-improving agent harnesses, including feedback loops, evaluation systems, and memory.

  • Build and maintain AI-powered backend services on top of LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini.

  • Write production code, particularly around agent runtime and orchestration.

  • Debug and improve AI behavior in production through prompt engineering, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Break down complex technical challenges into actionable milestones and prioritize the engineering roadmap.

  • Establish engineering standards around code reviews, testing, observability, and release processes.

  • Lead and support the engineering team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Previous technical leadership experience at an early-stage company (Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.

  • Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, including designing and maintaining APIs, services, and data flows.

  • Experience working with LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, model configuration, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation.

  • Daily hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools. You should know how to delegate work to agents, review their output, and verify what they build.

Nice to have

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience.

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or building custom agent runtimes.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Supabase, and pgvector.

â¢ Write a working solution for each task, for example a 5-day production plan, and confirm it can be solved in 60 to 75 minutes.

â¢ Worked inside systems of record (ERP, WMS) and with their exports or reports

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €234,000 - €246,000 per year.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC to play a key role in enhancing our sales productivity in our APAC region. This role will design, deliver, and continuously improve sales onboarding for our new hires. You will work closely with sales leadership, enablement, and product marketing to ensure our field salesforce is equipped with the skills, tools, and knowledge needed to achieve revenue targets and drive customer success.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead APAC Sales & Success onboarding by facilitating Notion’s Sales Bootcamp for new hires across the region

 - Own the APAC Onboarding Calendar end-to-end, ensuring a consistent, well-sequenced new-hire experience

 - Establish a clear communication cadence with APAC frontline leaders, setting expectations and ensuring visibility into each new hire’s onboarding plan and progress

 - Create engaging, multimodal learning experiences (AI-assisted content, short-form video, podcasts, and activity-based materials) that help sellers succeed in their segment and reach their full potential with Notion

 - Embed and reinforce Notion’s culture, product value, and customer-first mindset across all field enablement programs

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Strong executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and stakeholder management abilities

 - Clear understanding of B2B sales cycles, strategies, and buyers—ideally product-led growth, sales-led growth journeys, and enterprise sales

jobs.title: Senior Staff Infrastructure & Security Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CIVILGRID

CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer.

Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain-of-custody documentation. Teams at PG&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running.

We're a venture-backed Series A startup tackling a $4.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for.

WHY THIS ROLE

We're looking for a Security & Infrastructure Engineer to own our security posture and assist in supporting our cloud platform and reliability as we scale into large utilities and civil engineering firms. You'll take over and grow our security program, working across engineering, IT, and leadership. The role is on the Systems team that spans DevOps, SRE, and security. Your focus is security but you will contribute across the team.

This role reports to the Head of Engineering. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our Boston, MA office at least 3 days per week if hired.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with engineering to embed reliability and security into the SDLC and infrastructure decisions

  • Run our security program: SOC 2 readiness and audits, vendor reviews, access controls, endpoint security, and threat modeling

  • Define and enforce policies for identity, secrets, data handling, and production access across the company

  • Lead incident response for both security events, and some reliability events, from detection through resolution and follow-up

  • Harden and monitor our GIS servers (Windows Server) alongside our AWS platform

  • Build and maintain our Trust Center, and lead security reviews with customers

  • Contribute to our AWS environment end to end: VPC architecture, ECS, RDS, secrets management, IAM, networking, and cost optimization

  • Contribute to improving reliability practices: SLOs, observability, alerting, on-call rotation, runbooks, and blameless post-incident reviews

  • The tech:

    • AWS ECS, Postgres on RDS managed with CDK

    • GitHub, Datadog, Slack, Notion, Drata

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • At least 5-8 years of experience across product security, platform security, or security engineering, with hands-on experience with DevOps or SRE of production AWS infrastructure

  • Experience running or supporting a SOC 2 program, including evidence collection, control design, and auditor coordination

  • Deep working knowledge of AWS (VPC, ECS, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent)

  • Experience running vulnerability management, from scanner findings and outside reports to fixes shipped

  • Track record of improving reliability in production: defining SLOs, building observability, running on-call, and leading post-incident reviews

  • Startup ready: autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked

  • Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience supporting B2B products sold into regulated industries (utilities, energy, public sector)

HOW WE WORK

We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers â huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in-person collaboration where it matters and remote-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

The base salary range for this role is $137,318 - $192,960.

Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location.

In addition to base and equity, we offer:

  • Company-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance â including medical plans at no cost to the employee

  • FSA (health and dependent care)

  • Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it

  • 401(k) plan

  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment

  • A high-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply


Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

Qualification path

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

jobs.title: Kundeservicemedarbejder til international virksomhed i Sofia, Bulgarien
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om nye oplevelser, internationale kolleger og en hverdag i en spændende europæisk storby? Så har du nu muligheden for at kombinere et fast job med et nyt kapitel i Sofia!

Sofia byder på det bedste fra flere verdener: et levende byliv med hyggelige caféer, gode restauranter, kultur og et internationalt miljø. Samtidig får du en overkommelig leveomkostning, smuk natur lige uden for byen og gode muligheder for at udforske resten af Europa.

Vi varetager rekrutteringen til stillingen, og ansættelsen sker direkte hos vores kunde i Bulgarien.

 

Om jobbet

Vi søger dansktalende kundeservicemedarbejdere til en international virksomhed i Sofia.

Du bliver en del af et multikulturelt team, hvor du hjælper dansktalende kunder over telefonen med spørgsmål om mobilabonnementer og forskellige services.

Stillingen er uden salg, og tidligere erfaring med kundeservice er ikke et krav. Du får grundig oplæring, så du er godt klædt på til jobbet.

 

Hvad kan du se frem til?

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling med arbejdstid mandag–fredag kl. 10.00–19.00

  • Attraktiv lønpakke set i forhold til det lokale lønniveau samt mulighed for bonus.

  • Relocation package med midlertidig bolig og økonomisk støtte til flytningen

  • Sundhedsforsikring og andre personalegoder

  • Et internationalt arbejdsmiljø med kolleger fra forskellige lande

  • Muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling

  • Fri i weekenderne til at opleve Sofia og resten af Bulgarien

 

Hvem er du?

  • Du taler dansk på et højt professionelt niveau og kan kommunikere på engelsk

  • Er serviceminded og trives med at tale med mennesker

  • Har lyst til at bo og arbejde i udlandet

  • Er nysgerrig, fleksibel og klar til nye oplevelser

Uanset om du er i starten af din karriere, ønsker et miljøskifte eller drømmer om at prøve noget helt nyt, kan dette være muligheden for dig.

 

Arbejdssted: Sofia, Bulgarien (arbejde fra kontoret)

Opstart: 30. november 2026

 

Interesseret i stillingen?

Ser du muligheder i at kombinere et fast job i en international virksomhed med en hverdag i Sofia, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. 

Send os din ansøgning, eller kontakt os, hvis du ønsker at høre mere om stillingen og mulighederne for at flytte til Bulgarien.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, Eastern/Central Time
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based within U.S. and Canada Eastern or Central Time. You can work from anywhere within those time zones. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through all communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

What we're looking for

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

 - Based in U.S. or Canada Eastern or Central Time only.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $95,000—$135,000. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will work closely with our enterprise customers and engineers to resolve the most complex issues. You will also help build out systems and processes to manage tasks from report to completion. You will problem solve with our technical teams and work to resolve as much as you can while scaling our systems and support processes.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Resolve customer issues leveraging your technical expertise and act as the primary point of escalation for our external support teams.

 - Reproduce customer issues, perform initial triage and file software defects and feedback with Engineering

 - Work cross-functionally across engineering and product to build processes and manage issues.

 - Develop deep product and platform expertise, diagnose and prevent recurring issues while contributing to feedback loops that improve both product quality and existing workflows.

 - Manage to key performance metrics defined within the CX Team.

 - Create and maintain internal knowledge libraries and contribute to the creation of user-facing content.

 - Should be open to 24/5 shift model and participate in an on-call rotation to assist customers outside of normal working hours.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3-5 years in a support capacity focusing on escalated issue and/or technical troubleshooting. A track record of contributing to performance metrics like customer satisfaction and response time.

 - Exceptional problem-solving skills capable of diagnosing complex technical issues, querying data, and review product logs. You can drive problems to resolution efficiently and effectively.

 - Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners (i.e. Engineering, Product, and Operations) to drive long-term solutions and ensure customer feedback informs product improvements.

 - Proficiency in incorporating AI into day-to-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.

 - Experience contributing or owning projects to optimizing processes, workflows, and support operations that drive performance improvements. You have strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You are capable of distilling complex, technical material to non-technical audiences.

 - Ability to balance user expectations with policies and compliance boundaries. Ability to work under pressure while remaining focused and professional.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Strong analytical skills with a passion for interpreting data to improve decision-making and outcomes.

 - Experience with tools and technologies like Zendesk, SQL databases, APIs, AI tools.
   
   

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (London)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Replit is experiencing extraordinary demand and seeking an Enterprise Account Executive with strong communication skills to drive our hyper-growth. Candidates with SaaS experience, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.



This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects and customers, guiding them through the buying journey

 - Conduct compelling product demonstrations and help realize the art of the possible by orchestrating non-engineering hackathons

 - Articulate Replit's value proposition and align it with customers' business objectives

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy and successful delivery

 - Prepare tailored quotes and skillfully negotiate deals

 - Maintain accurate customer and forecasting data in Replit’s CRM (Hubspot)

 - Foster strong relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities for expanded adoption

 - Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing collaboration and support

 - Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience in AE or SE/technical sales role, preferably in SaaS or developer tools

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

 - Experience with, or direct observations of full-cycle sales, from prospecting to closing deals to managing existing customers

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet

 - Self-motivated with excellent time management and organizational skills

 - Passion for technology and staying current with industry trends

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus

 - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for client meetings and events
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
   
   


TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM

 - ZoomInfo

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You’re not based in London area

 - You lack an understanding of the software development lifecycle; have little to no coding knowledge

 - You’re not passionate about AI

 - You don’t enjoy being in client facing roles where 80% of your day is talking to others





Note: This role will begin as remote, with plans to transition to a hybrid model once we establish a local office presence.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA- MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA
jobs.description:
MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA- MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA

Kao obiteljsko poduzeće znamo da su ljudi ti, koji svojim znanjem i vještinama pridonose našem uspjehu. Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. Međusobna suradnja znači za nas međusobnu povezanost. Svi smo složni u uvjerenju da zajedno postižemo velike stvari.

Kao poduzeće. Kao tim. Kao obitelj.

Očekuju te sljedeći zadaci:

  • Redovito održavanje strojeva u proizvodnom pogonu
  • Utvrđivanje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima
  • Izvođenje servisa, remonta i montaže strojeva
  • Briga o zalihi rezervnih dijelova
  • Godišnje provođenje ispitivanja elektro uređaja

Što donosiš sa sobom:

  • Završena škola: elektrotehničar, elektromehaničar, mehatroničar ili električar, stručnjak za pneumatiku i hidrauliku
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo minimalno 2 godine u području održavanja pneumatskih i hidrauličnih strojeva
  • Pouzdanost i samostalnost u obavljanju radnih zadataka
  • Izraženi timski duh
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Poželjno poznavanje engleskog ili njemačkog jezika u govoru i pismu

Što te očekuje:

  • Rad u internacionalnom okruženju
  • Stimulativna primanja
  • Mogućnost napredovanja
  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme
  • Poticajna i prijateljska radna atmosfera
  • Uvođenje u posao pod vodstvom mentora
  • Dvosmjenski rad
  • Vrhunska oprema i postrojenje
  • Veliki benefit paket (npr. team building, božićni domjenak, sportske aktivnosti, osiguranje 0-24, uplata u 3. mirovinski stup i još mnoge pogodnosti)

jobs.title: Juhatuse liige
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: SA Narva Linna Arendus strateegiline ja igapäevane juhtimine, organisatsiooni tegevuse tulemuslikkuse ning majandusliku jätkusuutlikkuse tagamine. Peamised tööülesanded: - Sihtasutuse arengustrateegia kujundamine ja elluviimine. - Sihtasutuse hallatavate objektide, taristu ja muude ressursside tõhus majandamine ning arendamine. - Äkkeküla spordikeskuse arendamine ning selle võimaluste parem kasutamine spordi- ja turismiteenuste pakkumisel. - Uute teenuste, projektide ja täiendavate tuluallikate väljatöötamine. - Investeeringute ja rahastusvõimaluste leidmine ning arendusprojektide elluviimine. - Koostöö arendamine ettevõtjate, investorite, kohalike kogukondade, avaliku sektori ja teiste partneritega. - Organisatsiooni tööprotsesside, personali ja finantside juhtimine. - Kaasaegsete juhtimismeetodite, digilahenduste ja andmepõhise otsustamise rakendamine. - Narva atraktiivsuse suurendamine ning uute algatuste, sündmuste ja külastajate linna toomisele kaasaaitamine. - Sihtasutuse tegevuse majandusliku ja ühiskondliku mõju hindamine ning kokkulepitud eesmärkide saavutamine.
